title: Creative Strategist (Video Ads) for Fast-Growing E-commerce Brands
description:
We are two performance marketers running paid ads for fast-growing e-commerce brands across health, wellness, lifestyle, and premium consumer products. Our ads are scaling at a high spend on Meta. We have an in-house video editing team producing at volume.



We don't need someone to execute. We need someone who shows up and challenges us.

You will sit alongside us, not below us. You bring your own angles. You read the data and tell us what to test next. You look at a winning creative and already know why it's winning. You look at a dead creative and already know why it died.



If you've never built a creative strategy from scratch, don't apply.

If you don't know what an awareness level is, don't apply.

If you need us to explain the difference between an avatar and a demographic, don't apply.



We've worked with people who execute briefs. They delivered on time. They did exactly what was asked. Nothing new ever came from them. We're done with that.



What You'll Do



- Build creative strategies from scratch: avatars, sub-avatars, micro angles, awareness levels, hooks, ad angles

-Write video ad scripts that convert, from hook to offer

- Turn a micro angle into a clear, specific brief our editors can execute without guessing

- Own the creative pipeline: d
 what gets made, in what order, and why

- Analyze existing ads and tell us exactly why they're working or dying, with data to back it up

- Deliver multiple script variations per angle, built for split testing

- Come to us with angles we haven't thought of yet

- Iterate based on performance data, not aesthetics, not opinions, not feelings



You Already Know



How to build and define avatars, sub-avatars, and micro angles

How awareness levels work and how they change the creative approach

What makes a hook stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds vs get ignored

How to structure a video ad: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer

How to read Meta ad data and extract creative insights from it

How to write a brief so specific that an editor never has to ask a follow-up question

Why some creatives scale past $10,000 in spend and others die at $150



You Have



- A portfolio of video ads that actually ran and actually performed, with context on why

- Experience building creative strategies for e-commerce brands, not just executing briefs

- Experience briefing and directing editors, and holding them to a standard

- The ability to look at a brand, understand the avatar, and come back with angles we haven't considered

- A track record of working directly alongside media buyers or performance marketers

- Strong written English. Your briefs and scripts live or die on clarity

- The hunger to get better, not just to deliver and move on



We Offer



- Real budget behind your work. Your angles get tested with serious spend, not $50 a day

- An editing team that executes, so you stay on strategy instead of pushing pixels

- Fast feedback loops. You'll know within days whether your thinking was right

- Long-term collaboration. We're building something, not hiring for a project

- A seat at the table, not a task list



How to Apply



Send us:



Two video ads you built the strategy for. Tell us the avatar, the angle, the awareness level you targeted, and how it performed.

One ad of ours or a competitor's in the health/wellness space. Tell us why you think it works, and one angle we're missing.



Put ANGLE in the subject line so we know you read this to the end. Applications without it get deleted.

What happens next

If we like what you send, here's the process:



A call where you walk us through your thinking. Not a formal interview. We want to talk shop, push back on your ideas, and see how you handle it.

If the call goes well, a paid trial on a real brand with real budget. You build the strategy, we run it, we look at the numbers together.



We pay for the trial because your time is worth something and because we want to see how you actually work, not how you interview. If it clicks on both sides, we go long-term.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Position: Human Resource Manager / Consultant



Company: Veterans Educating Veterans

Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Reports To: Operations Manager / CEO



Responsibilities



As part of your role, you shall be responsible for the following human resource management functions:



A. Recruiting



Assist in identifying, screening, and interviewing candidates for open positions.



Coordinate with hiring managers to define job requirements and candidate qualifications.



Maintain candidate databases and pipelines for current and future staffing needs.



Develop and maintain standardized interview question sets and scoring rubrics.



Ensure all recruiting practices remain compliant with federal and state regulations.



B. Hiring



Facilitate the full hiring cycle, including extending job offers and coordinating start dates.



Handle all new employee onboarding procedures, including orientation, HR paperwork, benefits explanation (if applicable), and initial training coordination.



Ensure smooth transition of new hires into their respective roles through first-week and first-30-day check-ins.



Maintain updated new-hire packets, onboarding manuals, and checklists.



C. Firing / Employee Separation



Provide expert guidance on employee termination matters to leadership.



Prepare termination documentation, notices, and compliance forms.



Conduct exit interviews and track feedback for organizational improvement.



Ensure all separation procedures comply with labor laws, internal policies, and risk-mitigation standards.



D. Implementing Policies



Develop, revise, and implement HR policies, SOPs, and procedural guidelines.



Ensure all HR policies align with federal/state employment laws, industry standards, and organizational goals.



Create clear policy summaries and distribute updates to staff.



Train supervisors and staff on policy changes and compliance expectations.



Track policy acknowledgment receipts for audit readiness.



E. Disciplinary Actions



Work with leadership to design, implement, and monitor disciplinary action plans.



Ensure accurate documentation of all violations, warnings, and corrective steps.



Maintain fairness, consistency, and legal compliance throughout all disciplinary processes.



Provide coaching to managers on how to conduct disciplinary conversations professionally.



F. Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs)



Draft and implement comprehensive Performance Improvement Plans tailored to the employee’s role and deficiencies.



Establish clear metrics, timelines, and expectations for improvement.



Conduct follow-up meetings and maintain documentation for legal and operational compliance.



Guide supervisors on how to hold employees accountable during the PIP period.



Recommend training, coaching, or corrective actions based on PIP outcomes.



G. HR Event Preparedness & Upcoming Events



Prepare HR-related support plans for upcoming events (e.g., company meetings, trainings, audits, reviews, compliance deadlines).



Coordinate employee schedules, attendance expectations, and pre-event communication.



Ensure staff receive proper notice regarding policy changes, company-wide updates, and HR-related deadlines.



Assist with planning for seasonal staffing fluctuations or expected organizational changes.



Maintain readiness for surprise audits, compliance inspections, or emergency staffing adjustments.



H. General HR Benchmarking & Best Practices



Maintain and update HR metrics (turnover rate, time-to-hire, employee engagement trends, attendance data).



Ensure HR files are audit-ready and comply with federal and state documentation standards.



Conduct periodic compliance audits for employee files, I-9 forms, contractor agreements, job descriptions, and training certifications.



Monitor industry trends and update HR policies to reflect best practices.



Create templates, checklists, dashboards, and reports to support efficient and modern HR operations.



Advise leadership on workforce planning, contractor utilization, and job-role optimization.



Support workplace culture initiatives that promote retention, productivity, and professional behavior.



Other HR Functions as Needed



Provide ongoing HR support to leadership and staff.



Recommend improvements in employee engagement, compliance, communication, and workplace culture.



Assist in investigations, conflict resolution, and mediation when necessary.



Maintain strict adherence to confidentiality, data protection standards, and ethical HR practices.



Qualifications



Proven experience as an HR Manager, HR Consultant, or similar HR leadership role.



Strong understanding of recruitment, employee relations, termination processes, compliance, and policy development.



Knowledge of federal and state labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance standards.



Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills.



Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.



Strong organizational and documentation skills.



Proficiency in HR software, ATS systems, and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field required; HR certification (PHR/SHRM-CP) preferred.



Performance Expectations – HR Manager/Consultant



Recruitment Efficiency: Present qualified candidates within the agreed timeline for all open roles.



Hiring Accuracy: Complete onboarding with 100% compliance for every new hire.



Termination Compliance: Ensure separations are executed professionally, legally, and in accordance with policy to minimize risk.



Policy Implementation: Deliver updated HR policies within agreed timeframes and ensure clear staff communication.



PIP Management: Develop and track performance improvement plans with measurable progress and proper documentation.



Disciplinary Oversight: Provide fair, consistent, timely disciplinary recommendations and ensure documentation integrity.



HR Responsiveness: Resolve HR issues promptly and provide timely guidance to leadership.



Compliance & Audit Readiness: Maintain HR records, files, and logs in audit-ready condition at all times.



Collaboration: Work effectively with leadership and staff to support overall organizational goals.



Confidentiality: Uphold the highest standards of discretion regarding all HR matters.

title: Part-Time Contractor Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Part-Time Contractor Coordinator to contact, qualify, schedule, and follow up with contractors on behalf of our company.



This is a contractor-facing operations role. You will communicate with contractors by phone,
, and text. You will not communicate with our clients or patients.



We will give you the information needed for each request. Your job is to communicate accurately, gather the required information, keep the tracker current, and move the request to its next step. You must never guess at or independently answer a technical question. Any technical question must be recorded and escalated to the team.



Schedule

This role provides three paid working hours per day, Monday through Friday, for a total of 15 paid hours per week.



The specific three hours may be different on different days. Each day's three-hour block must fall entirely between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time. This is not a fixed daily shift, but reliable weekday coverage within that window is required.



Responsibilities

- Contact contractors by phone,
, and text.

- Introduce the company and explain the reason for contact using the project information provided by the team.

- Confirm whether the contractor serves the relevant location.

- Confirm whether the contractor has experience relevant to the approved scope.

- Ask about availability, lead time, and the contractor's quote or estimate process.

- Request relevant qualifications, licensing, and insurance information where applicable.

- Arrange appointments using the scheduling information provided by the company.

- Follow up professionally when a contractor has not responded, when information is missing, or when a promised quote has not arrived.

- Maintain an accurate contractor tracker with contact details, outreach attempts, responses, qualifications, availability, quote status, and appointment status.

- Record a clear next action after every interaction.

- Escalate technical questions, unclear scope items, and decisions requiring the company's input.

- Find and contact an alternative contractor when directed or when the agreed follow-up process calls for one.

- Protect private information and share only the minimum information a contractor needs for the approved request.



Important Role Boundaries

- You communicate with contractors only. You do not communicate with clients or patients.

- You never provide technical advice or independently answer a contractor's technical question.

- If you are unsure, record the question and escalate it to the team instead of guessing.



Requirements

- Clear spoken and written English.

- Experience making outbound and follow-up calls in a professional role.

- Professional, polite persistence across phone,
, and text follow-up.

- Very organized, with the ability to manage multiple contractor follow-ups without losing track of details.

- Accurate recordkeeping and confidence maintaining a contractor tracker.

- Experience using Notion.

- Able to record a specific next action after every interaction.

- Able to communicate project information accurately without adding unsupported details.

- Good judgment about when to follow up, when to escalate, and when an alternative contractor may be needed.

- Available for three paid hours each Monday through Friday, with each day's hours falling entirely between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.



Hiring Process

- Complete a short Tally Form application tally.so/r/Gx4qPo

- We will review the application.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid trial.



Compensation is set at $4 to $7 USD per hour, depending on experience.

title: AI Graphic Designer (ChatGPT & Nano Banana)
description:
GodSounds is looking for an AI Graphic Designer to create beautiful, high-converting marketing graphics using AI image generation tools such as ChatGPT and Nano Banana.



This position is focused on creating static images and carousel ads that we will use for Meta 
 & Instagram) advertising, websites, landing pages, and social media.



We’re not looking for traditional graphic design. We’re looking for someone who knows how to use AI to create professional, on-brand marketing images quickly and consistently.



The most important qualification is having a great eye for design, taste, and branding. We want images that look polished, premium, and natural—not obviously AI-generated.



What You’ll Do



* Create marketing graphics using ChatGPT, Nano Banana, and other AI image tools.

* Design static ads and carousel graphics for Meta advertising.

* Create images promoting our products, services, apps, audiobooks, and Christian resources.

* Generate multiple creative concepts from a single idea.

* Refine AI prompts until the images look clean, professional, and on-brand.

* Organize completed graphics for our marketing team.



Often your assignments will be simple, such as:



“Create 20 marketing images promoting this audiobook.”



or



“Create several carousel concepts promoting this app.”



Your job is to turn those ideas into polished marketing graphics that are ready to test in advertising campaigns.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has experience using ChatGPT image generation, Nano Banana, or similar AI image tools.

* Has excellent visual taste and knows what makes a graphic look premium.

* Can recognize when an AI image looks unrealistic or low quality and improve it.

* Understands branding and consistency.

* Can follow creative direction while also bringing fresh ideas.

* Is organized and communicates well.

* Wants to build a long-term working relationship.



Experience with Meta advertising creatives is a bonus but not required.



Hours



Initially this position will be:



* A few hours each week



As our marketing grows, this can expand into:



* 10+ hours per week



We are looking for someone interested in growing with our company long term.



Pay



Our current budget is:



* $3-$8 USD per hour, depending on experience, quality, speed, and creativity.



Trial Project



Please visit both of our websites:



GodSounds







PneumaBreath







After looking through both websites, create several marketing graphics that demonstrate your creativity.



Ideas include:



* Static Meta ad graphics

* Carousel ads

* Promotional images for an audiobook

* Promotional graphics for the PneumaBreath app

* Graphics highlighting free resources

* Brand awareness graphics

* Any additional creative ideas you think would perform well as ads



We are intentionally giving you creative freedom because we want to see your design style, prompt-writing ability, and overall eye for marketing.



Please submit your work in a Google Drive folder or another easy-to-view format.



When You Apply



Please include:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your hourly rate.

* Approximately how many hours you can work each week.

* Your test graphics based on the GodSounds and PneumaBreath websites



You can also look up GodSounds to learn more about our company and our mission.



If this position is a good fit, we expect it to become a long-term role as we continue growing our marketing efforts.

title: Sales Operations Administrator
description:
Welcome to MEGHANI, an independent timepiece company that believes in the power of time. MEGHANI is dedicated to surveying the relativity of individual and collective relationships within time and memory. Our commitment to exceptional design and storytelling is guided by this fundamental principle.



The purpose of what we create is rooted in a deep history of timekeeping; Now run by the third generation of family members, sibling duo Amir and Shabeena Meghani — MEGHANI is made up of a tight knit team of individuals who run our two in-house timepiece brands: BREDA & JBW. Welcome to our world.



The Sales Operations Administrator at MEGHANI is a full-time, hourly position reporting to the Wholesale Director. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our product catalog, pricing, and promotional content are accurate, up to date, and optimized for both internal teams and retail partners. You will work cross functionally with Merchandising, Product, Marketing, and Retail teams to streamline operational processes and maintain high quality digital and inventory data.



What You’ll Do



Product Launch & Templates

- Create and maintain product launch templates to ensure consistent data, imagery, and promotional information

- Coordinate with cross functional teams to collect necessary assets and information for new product launches.



Catalog & Inventory Management

- Conduct regular product audits to ensure inventory and product information is accurate and live.

- Update pricing and promotional details in systems and maintain accuracy across digital and retail channels

- Monitor inventory liveness to prevent stock discrepancies or issues affecting product availability



Digital Asset & Data Management

- Manage product imagery across platforms, ensuring correct specifications and organization.

- Maintain Drive and Dropbox folders, keeping all product and marketing assets well structured and up to date.

- Update and maintain retailer, internal, and vendor contact lists for accurate communication and outreach.



Process Improvement & Collaboration

- Identify inefficiencies in current product operations workflows and propose solutions.

- Partner with Marketing, Retail, and Product teams to implement best practices for product data and asset management.

- Support reporting and ad hoc requests related to product operations and inventory.



What You’ll Bring

- 2+ years of experience in product operations, merchandising, retail operations, or e-commerce support.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable managing multiple digital tools, cloud storage systems, and spreadsheets.

- Proficiency in Excel – Strong expertise required. Candidate must be highly skilled with advanced functions including VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, PivotTables, and related tools.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally.

- Proactive and solutions oriented with a focus on maintaining accurate, timely product data.



What You’ll Get:

- Competitive salary and performance incentives

- 4 ½ Day Work Week

- Discretionary Time Off (DTO)

- Employee discounts for both JBW and BREDA brands



Schedule:

Full Time. Eight (8) hours Monday through Thursday (8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST) and four (4) hours on Fridays (8:00 AM - 12:00 AM CST)

Content & Listing Optimization

 page

Administrative Support

- Assist in creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Maintain organized records and documentation.

- Support operations and special projects when needed.



Qualifications

- Experience in short-term rental (STR), Airbnb, vacation rental, or property management is required.

- Strong customer service background with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Extremely detail-oriented and organized. 

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

- Able to prioritize urgent tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

- Proactive, resourceful, and takes initiative.

- Quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes. 

- Available to work during U.S. business hours, including overnight/night shifts.

title: Outbound Sales Manager (Remote – Philippines)
description:
Compensation: $7/hr during the 3-month probation period; $8/hr after probation based on performance and overall fit.

Type: Full-time

Schedule: Must overlap with U.S. business hours (Pacific Time)

Experience Required: 3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience



About Us

We are a U.S.-based short-term rental management company built by investors, for investors.

We manage properties across multiple states and help owners improve performance through full-service management and revenue management. 



We operate on the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS), so we value accountability, clear ownership, consistent execution, and measurable results. As we continue to grow, we are looking for an outbound sales professional who can help us build a more consistent and reliable sales process. We need someone who can bring structure, consistency, and ownership to that process.



Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Outbound Sales Manager who will take full ownership of our outbound sales process. This person will be responsible for building, managing, and continuously improving our outbound sales efforts—from prospecting and outreach to follow-up, appointment setting, and reporting. title: QA Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING! JOIN OUR TEAM!



Position: QA Manager

Company: Baton (
)

Location: 100% Remote (WFH)

Work Hours: Mountain Standard Time

Rate/Salary: $8-10 per hour



About the Role



Baton is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented QA Manager to oversee quality assurance, compliance, buyer performance, and traffic quality across our call marketplace.



This role is responsible for monitoring call quality, publisher compliance, buyer performance, refund trends, and operational risks to ensure the marketplace maintains high standards of quality and accountability. The QA Manager will proactively identify issues, investigate root causes, and work cross-functionally with Publisher Management, Client Success, Operations, Sales, and Leadership to improve conversion outcomes, reduce preventable credits, and strengthen partner performance.



This is a highly visible role that combines quality assurance, compliance oversight, reporting, operational analysis, and process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



Credit & Refund Oversight

- Monitor credit and refund trends by buyer, campaign, publisher, sub-ID, and category.

- Identify recurring fail reasons, unusual approval rates, and emerging patterns.

- Investigate whether issues originate from traffic quality or buyer-side operational failures.

- Flag buyers with excessive refund requests or abnormal credit behavior.

- Develop recurring reports highlighting refund drivers and trends.

- Recommend corrective actions including routing adjustments, bid changes, publisher feedback, buyer coaching, and traffic filtering improvements.



Call Quality Assurance

- Review call recordings, transcripts, and call outcomes on a daily and weekly basis.

- Evaluate transfer quality, buyer call handling, and overall caller experience.

- Review AI-assisted call interactions where applicable.

- Identify fraud, coached callers, low-intent leads, wrong-service inquiries, compliance concerns, and other quality issues.

- Maintain a library of common quality issues, examples, and training materials.



Buyer Performance Monitoring

- Track buyer answer rates, connection rates, call handling effectiveness, and responsiveness.

- Identify buyers missing calls, creating poor caller experiences, or generating avoidable credits.

- Analyze operational issues impacting conversion performance.

- Surface trends by buyer, region, and campaign.

- Escalate performance concerns to Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Leadership teams.

- Support initiatives that improve buyer accountability and service levels.



Compliance Management

- Maintain publisher compliance records and documentation.

- Ensure required certifications, disclosures, traffic source information, and supporting materials are current and complete.

- Monitor renewal and recertification requirements.

- Review landing pages, disclaimers, and traffic source declarations for compliance.

- Investigate TCPA-related concerns and other compliance alerts.

- Escalate high-risk publishers or traffic sources when necessary.

- Maintain audit-ready compliance documentation.



Alert Monitoring & Investigation

- Monitor alerts related to fraud, TCPA risk, answer-rate issues, abnormal call behavior, and - refund spikes.

- Conduct root cause investigations and document findings.

- Recommend and track corrective actions.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve recurring issues.



Reporting & Trend Analysis

- Develop and maintain QA scorecards and performance dashboards.

- Create recurring reports for leadership on:

- Traffic quality

- Buyer performance

- Refund trends

- Compliance risk

- Operational performance

- Translate data into actionable recommendations.

- Measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time.



SOP Ownership & Process Improvement

- Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures for:

- Call reviews

- Compliance reviews

- Refund investigations

- Escalation management

- Quality assurance processes

- Standardize QA definitions, audit criteria, and review methodologies.

- Improve workflows between QA, Publisher Management, Sales, Client Success, and Operations.

- Assist with training and coaching around recurring quality and compliance issues.



Escalation Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for quality and compliance escalations.

- Route issues to the appropriate teams and stakeholders.

- Track investigations through resolution.

- Identify systemic issues and implement long-term solutions.



Additional Responsibilities

- Audit call disposition accuracy and consistency.

- Review category mapping and call routing logic.

- Monitor buyer coverage failures and no-answer trends.

- Support dispute resolution through call reviews and documentation.

- Maintain training examples of approved versus non-approved traffic.

- Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve dashboards, alerts, and reporting.

- Help establish thresholds for buyer warnings, pauses, and escalations.



Qualifications



Required

- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, Operations, Call Center Management, - Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and investigative skills.

- Experience reviewing call recordings, transcripts, and performance data.

- Ability to identify trends and root causes across large datasets.

- Strong reporting and dashboard experience.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience creating SOPs, documentation, and process improvements.



Preferred

- Experience in pay-per-call, lead generation, affiliate marketing, or call marketplaces.

- Familiarity with TCPA compliance and call tracking platforms.

- Experience working with publisher networks, buyers, and performance marketing ecosystems.

- Experience with AI-driven call handling or conversational AI platforms.

- Experience using CRM, BI, and reporting tools.



Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Accurate and timely delivery of credit and refund trend reporting.

- Percentage of active publishers reviewed monthly.

- Percentage of high-risk buyers audited monthly.

- Time to investigate and escalate quality concerns.

- Reduction in preventable credits and refunds.

- Reduction in buyer-side answer rate and connectivity issues.

- Reduction in invalid, misrouted, or wrong-category calls.

- Compliance documentation completion and audit readiness.

- Alert investigation and resolution rates.

- QA audit volume, quality, and turnaround time.



What Success Looks Like



The successful QA Manager will create visibility into marketplace quality, identify risks before they become costly problems, improve buyer and publisher accountability, strengthen compliance standards, and help Baton maximize revenue by reducing preventable credits and operational inefficiencies.

title: Creative and Brand Design Consultant

Position Title: Creative and Brand Design Consultant

Location: Remote

Status: Contractor



Company Profile: 

Metal Building Outfitters is a trusted supplier of high-quality metal building solutions for residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial projects. We are committed to providing durable products, expert guidance, and exceptional customer service while helping our customers find the right solution for every building.  Our success is built on integrity, reliability, industry expertise, and a proactive approach to meeting our customers' needs. We believe our people are our greatest asset and foster a culture of teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement, where every employee plays an important role in our company's growth and success.  If you're looking to join a company that values hard work, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence, we invite you to explore a career with Metal Building Outfitters.



Position Purpose: 



The Creative & Brand Design Consultant is responsible for leading and maintaining the visual identity of Metal Building Outfitters by developing high-quality, brand-consistent marketing assets that support the company's growth and marketing initiatives. This position collaborates with management to establish and uphold brand standards, design compelling advertising and social media content, and deliver creative assets on a consistent schedule. The Creative & Brand Design Consultant manages the creative process from concept through final delivery, develops multiple design variations to support marketing campaigns, and provides organized, editable source files for internal use. This role serves as the company's creative advisor by recommending innovative design strategies, improving production efficiencies, and ensuring all visual communications reflect the professionalism and quality of the Metal Building Outfitters brand while contributing to increased brand awareness, customer engagement, and business growth.



Job Duties and Responsibilities: 



Develop, maintain, and enforce Metal Building Outfitters' brand identity and visual standards across all marketing materials and communication channels. 

Audit existing marketing assets and collaborate with management to establish comprehensive brand guidelines, including typography, color palettes, imagery, and design standards. 

Design high-quality digital marketing assets, including paid advertisements, social media graphics, promotional materials,
 graphics, presentations, and other branded collateral. 

Create high-converting advertising creatives for digital marketing platforms including Meta, Google Display, LinkedIn, and other online advertising channels. 

Produce engaging organic social media content that aligns with the company's marketing strategy and content calendar. 

Develop multiple creative variations for A/B testing to improve campaign performance, customer engagement, and conversion rates. 

Collaborate with management and the marketing team to translate business objectives into effective visual marketing campaigns. 

Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting established deadlines and maintaining a consistent production schedule. 

Deliver completed creative assets on a recurring weekly and monthly schedule to support ongoing marketing initiatives. 

Organize and maintain all creative files, templates, and digital assets using standardized file management practices. 

Provide fully editable source files, including Adobe Photoshop files and Canva templates, to support internal editing and future marketing needs. 

Ensure all creative materials meet company quality standards, brand guidelines, and platform specifications before publication. 

Research emerging design trends, marketing strategies, and creative technologies to continuously improve the company's visual presence and marketing effectiveness. 

Recommend process improvements, design systems, and workflow efficiencies that enhance productivity and consistency. 

Serve as the company's primary creative resource and advisor by providing professional design expertise and innovative solutions. 

Coordinate revisions and incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining project timelines and creative integrity. 

Support special projects, product launches, company events, and additional marketing initiatives as assigned. 

Maintain confidentiality of company branding, marketing strategies, and proprietary business information. 

 Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support the goals and objectives of Metal Building Outfitters.





Qualifications: 



Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, Fine Arts, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience may be considered. 

Minimum of three (3) years of professional experience in graphic design, brand development, or creative marketing, with experience supporting digital marketing campaigns. 

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Canva, with the ability to efficiently create both custom designs and scalable template-based assets.

Strong understanding of branding principles, typography, color theory, layout, and visual communication. 

Experience designing digital advertising creatives for platforms such as Meta 
/Instagram), Google Display, LinkedIn, and other online marketing channels. 

Knowledge of direct-response marketing principles and designing creative assets that drive engagement, click-through rates (CTR), and conversions. 

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Strong organizational skills with experience maintaining structured digital asset libraries and editable source files. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments. 

Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision. 

Ability to accept constructive feedback, adapt to changing priorities, and continuously improve creative output.

title: Catalog Growth Strategy - For Established Educational Catalogue
description:
I help people reduce and eliminate pain using yoga and yoga therapy.

I have a large database of on demand courses which I want to help my customers access more readily. 



Purpose of the Role - Your Outcomes



Increase customer lifetime value by improving customer progression through the existing catalog - making it easier for customers to discover, purchase, and benefit from the next most relevant course. Rather than asking customers to find the next course themselves, the catalog should naturally guide them toward the most relevant next step.



The immediate focus is improving customer progression ahead of the September Therapeutic Yoga for Shoulders and Hips (TYSH) launch and the fall Therapeutic Yoga Intensive (TYI). Longer term, learnings will be applied to the December 2026 consumer launch and a scalable catalog experience through 2027.



Key Indicators



Doubling TYSH registrations, 

Average time between first and second purchase: currently ~10 months —> reduce it

Increase qualified customers naturally progressing into TYI 



Note - Doubling registrations is not the primary objective - it is the indicator that improvements to the first-to-second purchase experience are working.



Context You'll Be Working With



Customers have almost no interaction with the catalog once inside the classroom (we are in process of fixing this)

No deliberate nurture sequence yet for the second purchase (in progress-we are fixing this)

Professional vs. consumer segmentation in the post-purchase experience is minimal

Consumer research for the December 2026 launch is underway

An August pilot program with pre-launch access may provide additional behavioural insights



Step 1 — Analyze First-to-Second Purchase Behaviour



Data provided: first?second purchase conversion rate; most common first purchases; most common second purchases; time between purchases; which second purchases most frequently lead to TYSH; factors contributing to the 10-month delay.



Tasks:



Analyze the provided data for patterns and bottlenecks in the first-to-second purchase journey

Identify which second purchases most frequently lead to TYSH

Identify factors contributing to the average 10-month delay





Measurable outcomes:



 Summary of key patterns and bottlenecks delivered

 Recommendations for improving second-order conversion delivered

 List of additional reports, data, or access that would improve the analysis



Step 2 — Quiz Setup & Nurture Sequence



Tasks:



Review the Power of the Pits course to understand the customer experience and identify opportunities to better guide customers to an appropriate next step

Collaborate on the post-course pathway, likely including:



Post-course quiz

Recommendation logic based on customer outcomes (wrist relief ? X, neck relief ? Y, back relief ? Z)

Classroom prompts



Measurable outcomes:



 Quiz and recommendation framework delivered (if appropriate)

 Recommendations for improving movement from first purchase to second purchase delivered



Step 3 — Initial Tests Toward the September Launch



Tasks:



Recommend and prioritize the smallest practical, highest-signal changes that can be implemented as seeding toward the September launch

Prioritize simple tests likely to produce meaningful learning and measurable improvements



Measurable outcomes:



 Prioritized list of tests delivered

 Approved tests implemented before the September launch



Phase 4 — Review Early Results



Tasks:



Review initial performance of implemented changes against:



First-to-second purchase conversion

Time between first and second purchase

Progression into TYSH

Early progression toward TYI



Recommend whether to continue, refine, expand, or replace the implemented strategies



Measurable outcomes:



 Performance review delivered against the four measures above

 Continue / refine / expand / replace recommendation for each implemented change



Secondary Work Stream (after initial changes are made)



Pattern-recognition analysis on a spreadsheet of anonymized historical purchases, looking for leading indicators of how and why people move through the courses at different paces or in different orders — so the right content reaches the right people, capturing 
ntum without creating friction by moving them too quickly



Skills and Experience Required 



Spreadsheet analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) — pattern recognition on purchase data

 marketing platform experience — segmentation, nurture sequences

Quiz/recommendation logic setup

Clear written English for summaries and recommendations

Self-directed, comfortable with a freeform, evolving scope within a phased structure



Experience with Catalogue of Courses,
 Platforms is required.



How Success Is Measured



Deliverables from each step completed as listed above

Movement on the key indicators: first-to-second conversion, time-to-second-purchase, TYSH registrations toward 125 / $20K, and early TYI progression



The 4 week project is $925 USD

description:

We need a skilled Canva video designer to create reusable video templates for personalized real estate outreach.

We contact families connected to properties with public-record issues such as unpaid property taxes, deceased owner records, missing probate, title transfer problems, lawsuits, or heirship issues.

The video should feel helpful, calm, professional, and trustworthy. It should NOT look like a flashy social media ad. It should feel like a public-record walkthrough where we show the person what we found and explain it clearly.

What You Will Create:

You will create one reusable Canva video template that our team can edit for different properties.

The template should allow us to quickly replace:

Name

Property address

Tax amount

Date of tax record

County website screenshots

Obituary screenshot

Probate/court screenshot

Lawsuit screenshot

Cost estimate numbers

Callback number

Final call-to-action

The video will use screenshots from public county websites. You will need to make the screenshots easy to understand by adding:

Zoom-ins

Highlight boxes

Arrows

Callouts

Large readable numbers

Simple text labels

Smooth transitions

Clean slide timing

Voiceover:

We will likely record the voiceover ourselves. Your job is to build the Canva video so the slides, screenshots, numbers, and animations can be synced to the recorded voiceover.

The scenes should be easy to stretch, shorten, duplicate, hide, or delete depending on the property.

Strong Canva video design experience

Canva template creation

Video editing

Motion graphics / animated callouts

Presentation design

Clean typography

Mobile-readable design

Ability to create reusable templates

Good English comprehension

Real estate videos

Professional service videos

Explainer videos

Sales presentation videos

Direct-response video / VSL style

CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools

Deliverables:

A 20-30 second paid sample first.

If the sample is good, one full editable Canva video template.

8-12 modular Canva scenes/pages.

Clearly labeled optional scenes, such as:Tax delinquency found

Obituary found

No probate found

Lawsuit found

Multiple properties

Cost estimate

Family/heir coordination

Final callback request



Simple instructions inside the Canva file explaining what to edit, duplicate, hide, or delete.

One completed sample video using the property details and screenshots we provide.

Style Direction:

Calm

Professional

Trust-building

Helpful

Clean

Not flashy

Not cheesy

Not overly animated

Not cluttered

Easy to read on mobile

To Apply:

Please reply with:

Your Canva video portfolio or 2-3 examples of Canva videos/templates you created.

Your experience creating reusable Canva templates.

Your experience syncing slides or animations to voiceover.

Your expected hourly rate.

Your fixed-price quote for a 20-30 second paid sample.

Your fixed-price quote for the full Canva template.

Your estimated turnaround time for the sample.

Your estimated turnaround time for the full template.

The word “RECORDS” at the top of your application so I know you read the full post.

Structure it like this:

If someone is clearly stronger and has a real video/motion portfolio, you can offer $50. But I would not go above that for the test.

title: Senior Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Reporting to: Commercial Manager

Hours: 9:00am – 5:00pm UK time (GMT/BST), Monday to Friday

Rate: $12–$16 USD per hour, depending on experience



Summary of Role

Do you want to be part of a fast-paced, young and entrepreneurial business? Velocity Commerce was born in Cambridge, UK in 2012 and has grown into an award-winning business working across Amazon marketplace growth and the home audio retail sector. Whether we are developing Amazon marketplace strategies or launching new products across our audio range, we work in a fast-moving, commercially focused environment where ideas are welcome, ownership is encouraged, and performance matters.



We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Amazon PPC Specialist (3+ years' hands-on experience minimum) to take ownership of and grow Amazon advertising activity across our catalogue, assisting in the management of circa £1.5m in annual PPC spend. This is a senior, results-driven role for someone who can deliver from day one, not learn on the job. The successful candidate will have proven, hands-on experience with Amazon Ads Console and Pacvue (or a similar advanced Amazon advertising platform), ideally with exposure to Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and a demonstrable track record of optimising PPC campaigns and driving measurable commercial results.



This role would suit a highly experienced, commercially minded Amazon PPC specialist with a strong track record of taking ownership of advertising performance and delivering results. Performance in this role will be judged against clear PPC spend efficiency and TACoS targets, so we need someone who can prove real, delivered impact, not just theoretical knowledge.



The Role

As Senior Amazon PPC Specialist, you will assist in managing circa £1.5m of annual Amazon advertising spend, taking ownership of PPC performance across our catalogue, managing bids, budgets, targeting and reporting across Amazon Ads Console, Pacvue (or a similar tool) and Amazon DSP. You will identify performance issues and opportunities, recommend data-led actions, and work closely with internal teams across content, stock, category and commercial planning to improve advertising performance and profitability.



Main Responsibilities

- Manage and optimise Amazon PPC campaigns across multiple marketplaces

- Build, monitor and improve campaigns within Amazon Ads Console

- Use Pacvue or a similar tool to review bids, budgets, pacing and performance trends

- Work across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display

- Manage bid strategies across manual and automated campaigns, including placement and keyword/target-level adjustments

- Apply dayparting (hour-of-day and day-of-week scheduling) to optimise spend efficiency

- Set, monitor and pace budgets across campaigns and marketplaces to hit spend and TACoS targets

- Carry out ongoing negative keyword and negative ASIN targeting ("negating") to eliminate wasted spend

- Track and act on search term, conversion and seasonal trends to inform bid and budget decisions

- Support DSP activity, audience targeting and performance reporting

- Assist with AMC analysis, insight generation and action planning

- Carry out keyword research, search term analysis and ASIN targeting

- Use Helium 10 for keyword research, tracking and competitor analysis

- Produce clear performance reports with practical recommendations



Key Skills/Competencies



Essential:

- Minimum 3+ years' proven, hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC accounts, with clear evidence of results delivered

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Ads Console

- Essential, non-negotiable: hands-on experience using Pacvue or a similar advanced Amazon advertising management tool

- Advanced bid management experience, manual and automated bidding, with placement and keyword/target-level adjustments

- Practical experience with dayparting / hour-of-day scheduling to optimise performance

- Strong budget management and pacing skills across multiple campaigns and marketplaces

- Rigorous approach to negative keyword and negative ASIN targeting ("negating") to eliminate wasted spend

- Comfortable identifying and acting on performance trends (search term, conversion, seasonality) to protect and improve TACoS

- Experience using Helium 10 for keyword research, tracking and analysis

- Strong, proven strategy experience across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display

- Proven, demonstrable track record of optimising PPC campaigns and improving spend efficiency / TACoS, able to give concrete examples, not just theory

- Confident with Excel or Google Sheets for reporting and analysis

- Able to spot issues quickly and make performance-led decisions

- Proactive, analytical and commercially minded

- Comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day PPC activity

- Strong attention to detail and organised working style

- Clear written English and confident communication



Desirable (but not essential):

- Familiarity with Seller Legend or similar Amazon analytics and reporting tools

- Amazon DSP experience preferred but not essential

- Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) experience preferred but not essential

- Experience working with a consumer product catalogue, ideally within home audio or electronics

- Experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns across multiple UK and EU marketplaces

- Experience running paid social media ads (e.g. Meta Ads) and/or Google Ads, alongside Amazon advertising



Screening Questions (please answer in your application):

1. Walk us through a Pacvue (or similar tool) campaign you personally restructured, what was the problem, what did you change, and what was the measurable impact on TACoS or spend efficiency?

2. Walk us through how you approach bid management and dayparting on a live campaign, how do you d
 when to adjust bids by placement or time of day, and how do you handle negative keyword/ASIN management to control wasted spend?

3. What PPC spend / TACoS targets have you been personally accountable for in your last role, and how did your actual results compare to target?

Content Optimization Rate: Track the percentage of pages optimized monthly, focusing on improving metadata, headings, and on-page content.

On-Page Optimization: Optimize metadata, headings, and content to enhance search engine visibility and relevance.

Technical SEO: Conduct regular audits and address crawlability, page speed, and mobile usability issues.

Performance Monitoring: Track and report on keyword rankings, organic traffic, and other key SEO metrics.

title: Walmart Operations Lead
description:
Zoyava is a fast-growing digital-native supplement brand focused on building premium wellness products that consumers genuinely love. As we continue scaling across major eCommerce marketplaces, Walmart Marketplace has become a key strategic growth channel for the business.



We are looking for a highly experienced Walmart Operations Lead to take ownership of Walmart Marketplace performance, drive operational excellence, and help scale the channel into a major revenue driver for the company.



This is a leadership role for someone who understands Walmart deeply, thinks strategically about growth, communicates clearly with leadership, and can build scalable systems across catalog, advertising, inventory, promotions, and reporting.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re seeking a highly analytical, growth-oriented operator with deep Walmart Marketplace experience who can lead the day-to-day operations and long-term strategy of the Walmart channel.



This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled brands on Walmart Marketplace, understands Walmart Connect advertising, knows how to improve operational performance, and can proactively identify growth opportunities while keeping leadership informed through strong reporting and business insights.



You should be comfortable owning the Walmart business like it’s your own.



Key Responsibilities



Walmart Marketplace Ownership



• Lead and oversee all Walmart Marketplace operations across the brand.

• Own channel growth, revenue performance, profitability, and operational execution.

• Develop and execute Walmart growth strategies focused on sales expansion, margin improvement, and market share.

• Manage end-to-end catalog operations including listings, variations, compliance, SEO, inventory health, and pricing. • Ensure all listings are optimized for discoverability, conversion, and Walmart algorithm performance.

• Monitor account health, policy compliance, suppression risks, and operational KPIs.



Walmart Growth & Strategy



• Identify new opportunities for growth through assortment expansion, promotions, pricing strategies, search visibility, and advertising optimization.

• Analyze category trends, competitor activity, and Walmart platform changes to maintain competitive advantage.

• Develop launch strategies for new products and ensure successful execution on Walmart Marketplace.

• Drive initiatives that improve conversion rate, traffic, ROAS, contribution margin, and repeat purchase behavior.



Walmart Connect Advertising



• Lead Walmart Connect advertising strategy and execution.

• Oversee campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding strategy, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.

• Continuously optimize ad efficiency and profitability through data analysis and testing.

• Report on advertising performance, attribution, TACOS, ROAS, and growth opportunities.



Leadership Reporting & Business Insights



• Build and maintain clear reporting systems for leadership.

• Provide weekly and monthly business updates with actionable insights, growth opportunities, risks, and operational recommendations.

• Track and report key Walmart KPIs including revenue, profitability, conversion rate, traffic, ROAS/TACOS, Buy Box %, inventory health, advertising efficiency, and listing health.

• Present strategic recommendations backed by data.



Cross-Functional Leadership



• Collaborate closely with creative, supply chain, operations, customer service, and leadership teams to ensure alignment across the Walmart business.

• Work with creative teams to improve listing assets, storefronts, and conversion-focused content.

• Coordinate with operations and inventory teams to maintain strong in-stock rates and avoid supply disruptions.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for Walmart account managers and external partners.



SOPs & Operational Excellence



• Develop scalable SOPs, workflows, and systems for Walmart operations.

• Improve operational efficiency across listing management, reporting, launches, and advertising workflows.

• Help build a world-class Walmart growth engine within the company. Skills & Requirements

• 4–7+ years of hands-on Walmart Marketplace experience with a proven track record of scaling brands.

• Deep understanding of Walmart Marketplace operations, catalog structure, SEO, and compliance.

• Strong experience managing Walmart Connect advertising at scale.

• Proven ability to analyze data and make growth-focused business decisions.

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets reporting and analytical skills.

• Strong understanding of profitability, contribution margin, inventory planning, and marketplace economics.

• Exceptional communication and leadership skills.

• Highly organized with strong project management abilities.

• Ability to operate independently and take full ownership of results.

• Experience in supplements, wellness, CPG, or fast-paced eCommerce brands is highly preferred.



What We Offer



• Opportunity to lead and scale a high-growth Walmart Marketplace business.

• A fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with strong growth potential.

• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

• Health insurance (HMO) and unlimited PTO.

This is a fully remote position and requires a reliable high-speed internet connection and a personal computer or laptop.

Learning & Development, Leadership Development, or Executive Management.

development opportunity.

another designated advisor. 



Required Qualifications

o Business Development 

o Enterprise Lead Qualification 

o Consultative Appointment Setting 

o B2B Inside Sales 

o Professional Services Sales Support

similar platforms.

Required Skills 

• Consultative selling 

• Executive-level conversations 

• Discovery interviewing 

• Active listening 

• Objection handling 

• Business acumen 

• Strategic questioning 

• Relationship building 

• Ability to discuss leadership development and talent challenges with senior executives 



Preferred Experience 

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: 

• Leadership Development 

• Executive Coaching 

• Corporate Training 

• Talent Management 

• Human Resources Consulting 

• Organizational Development 

• Learning & Development 

• B2B Professional Services 



Experience supporting US, European, or Latin American markets is a strong advantage. 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Monthly Performance Metrics 

• 100% response rate to engaged
 leads within 24 hours

You know how to ask thoughtful questions, uncover organizational challenges, evaluate strategic 

fit, and qualify opportunities based on business value rather than call volume.

title: Meta Creative Strategist — E-Commerce Performance Ads
description:
We are two performance marketers running paid ads for fast-growing e-commerce brands across health, wellness, lifestyle, and premium consumer products.



We don't need someone to execute.?We need someone who shows up and challenges us.



You will sit alongside us — not below us. You bring your own angles. You read the data and tell us what to test next. You look at a winning creative and already know why it's winning. You look at a dead creative and already know why it died.



If you've never built a creative strategy from scratch — don't apply.?If you don't know what an awareness level is — don't apply.?If you need us to explain the difference between an avatar and a demographic — don't apply.?If your portfolio is full of pretty fashion shots and generic dropship ads — don't apply.



We've worked with designers before. They were talented. They made beautiful things. Nothing converted. We're done with that.



What You'll Do

* Analyze existing ad creatives and tell us exactly why they're working or dying — with data to back it up

* Build creative strategies from scratch — avatars, sub-avatars, micro angles, awareness levels, hooks, ad angles

* Translate a micro angle and avatar into a high-converting visual concept independently

* Design and produce the creatives yourself — single images, carousels, comparison ads, proof-based visuals

* Generate realistic AI people — matched lighting, matched skin tone, indistinguishable from real photography

* Composite product shots, lifestyle visuals, and AI-generated scenes into clean conversion-focused creatives

* Deliver multiple variations per angle — built for split testing

* Come to us with new angles we haven't thought of yet

* Iterate based on performance data — not aesthetics, not opinions, not feelings



You Already Know

* How to build and define avatars, sub-avatars, and micro angles

* How awareness levels work and how they change the creative approach

* What makes a hook stop the scroll vs get ignored

* How to read Meta ad data and extract creative insights from it

* How visual hierarchy works in a performance creative

* Which AI tool wins for which job — Midjourney, Firefly, Generative Fill, or whatever gets the result

* How to make AI-generated people look real — not AI. Real.

* Why some creatives scale past $1000 spend and others die at $150



You Have

* A portfolio of Meta ad creatives that actually ran and actually performed — with context on why

* Experience building creative strategies for e-commerce brands — not just executing briefs

* Strong Photoshop and compositing skills — scene-building, lighting, retouching

* The ability to look at a brand, understand the avatar, and come back with angles we haven't considered

* A track record of working directly alongside media buyers or performance marketers

* The hunger to get better — not just to deliver and move on



We Offer

* Long-term collaboration — we're building something, not hiring for a project

* Consistent work with real performance feedback and clear direction

* Access to high-level marketing courses and resources — the kind most people pay thousands for

* Competitive pay based on quality, strategy, and output

* A seat at the table — not a task list

???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.



The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.

He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone, even the busiest and least motivated.

Talent Upstream is hiring Talent Researchers to help us identify and recruit high-performing Go-To-Market professionals across multiple industries.



This is a sourcing-first role designed for someone who enjoys finding great people before anyone else does.



Compensation

$5.00 - $6.00 USD per hour



Daily Responsibilities



Research and identify high-quality candidates.

Source talent through LinkedIn,
, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.

Utilize Chrome sourcing extensions and AI-assisted messaging.

Conduct outbound outreach and build relationships with passive candidates.

Qualify prospective candidates.

Schedule qualified candidates into our interview process.

Build and maintain a healthy recruiting pipeline within our CRM.

Performance Expectations



Success in this role is built through consistency. While interviews and hires are important outcomes, building a strong pipeline of qualified candidates is what drives long-term success.



Daily Success Metrics:



Activity - Goal

New prospects identified 50

Initial outreach messages 50

Follow-up messages 25

Candidate conversations 5

Interviews Scheduled 2



Weekly Success Metrics:



Activity - Goal

New prospects identified 250

Initial outreach messages 250

Follow-up messages 125

Candidate conversations 25

Interviews Held 5



We understand that not every conversation results in an interview, and not every interview results in a hire. These performance metrics are designed to encourage consistent effort, build a robust CRM, and create a sustainable pipeline of qualified candidates that fuels long-term growth.



What Makes This Different



Every Talent Researcher begins by learning how to source candidates through social media, our Chrome sourcing tools, and AI-assisted outreach.



As you demonstrate consistent performance and the ability to identify quality talent, you'll earn access to company-purchased recruiting leads, allowing you to increase your productivity and earning potential.



Top performers receive the best resources.



What We Provide:

Chrome sourcing tools

AI messaging tools

Applicant Tracking System (ATS)

Recruiting scripts

Interview training

Ongoing coaching and mentorship



We're Looking For:

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Self-motivated and results-oriented

Comfortable with outbound recruiting and social sourcing

Organized with strong attention to detail

Coachable and eager to learn

Previous recruiting or sales experience is a plus, but not required



Career Growth:



Talent Upstream is in its early stages, giving you the opportunity to grow with the company.



As we expand, we'll promote leaders from within, provide additional resources to top performers, and invest in the people who help us build something exceptional.

title: Customer Support Agent for a 8 Figure Shopify Brand
description:
Our brand is looking for a Customer Support Agent to join our fast-growing e-commerce team! As part of our support department, you’ll be the voice of the customer within the company — ensuring every shopper feels safe, heard, and cared for.



Your mission is simple but critical: fast responses, empathetic communication, and proactive problem-solving that keeps customers happy and prevents disputes or chargebacks.



If you’re someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves helping people, and can stay calm under pressure while handling multiple tasks, we’d love to meet you.





WHO ARE WE?

We are dedicated to building a brand that customers trust and love. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly by focusing on high-quality products, an excellent customer experience, and a culture of speed and ownership. Our customers are at the center of everything we do — and our support team is the heart of that mission.





  

WHAT IS OUR CULTURE AND WHO IS A GOOD FIT? 

Culture-fit is our #1 hiring factor. We are a small, fast, and ambitious team. No task is too small if it helps our customers and our growth. We live by the following 4 core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king", and "better every day". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to 20M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth by being hands-on, active, and doing what is necessary, with an excellent bonus plan based on performance, then you have come to the right place.







KEY OBJECTIVES:

- Respond to all customer inquiries within 6–24 hours (faster for first replies).

- Use empathy and tone-mirroring to de-escalate upset customers.

- Prevent disputes and chargebacks by proactively offering solutions.

- Follow SOPs for order checks, supplier follow-ups, refunds, and replacements.

- Manage reviews: encourage positive ones, resolve negative ones.

- Moderate 
ments and redirect customers to the official product pages.

- Keep communication loops closed: the last message should always be ours.









REQUIREMENTS

- Fully remote.

- Fluent in written and spoken English.

- Previous customer support experience in e-commerce (2+ years)

- Excellent written communication skills (clear, empathetic, friendly).

- Strong problem-solving mindset: can think fast and resolve issues calmly.

- Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Gmail, ticketing softwares, Slack.

- Flexible availability — can handle weekend and evening work

- Obsessed with speed: you reply before the customer even starts worrying.









ACCOUNTABILITIES

- Handle
 tickets, social comments, PayPal disputes, and reviews daily.

- Ensure suppliers/warehouses reply within 24 hours on customer issues.

- Spot and confirm fraudulent or incorrect orders before shipping.

- Attention to details, make sure to start your application with the word Green, or you will not receive a reply

- Close every ticket properly and follow up with the customer if needed.

- Document all customer insights and recurring issues for the team.

- Communicate clearly with the team at shift start and end.







SALARY EXPECTATION

Competitive base salary (USD $3 to 4.5$ per hour, depending on experience) + performance-based bonuses tied to customer satisfaction and dispute rate.



BONUS

If the CSAT is over 4.2, FST time is below 2 hours, and Resolution time is below 3 days you will get $100 each month.







SCREENING QUESTIONS TO APPLY

(If not, we will not consider your application)



1. What attracted you to this role?

2. Do you have prior experience in e-commerce support? How long? Any brands you worked with that we may know?

3. How do you typically calm down an angry or emotional customer?

4. What was your CSAT, FRT and Resolution time?

5. Are you comfortable working evenings/weekends? 7 days a week?

6. What is your expected monthly rate for a full-time remote role?

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
We shoot great content constantly — and almost none of it gets posted on time. Fabulr Studios is a premium video and podcast production studio inside Scale Space in White City, London, working with science, tech, and corporate clients who expect polish. Our founder is a producer, not a scheduler, and the gap between "we filmed something great this week" and "it's live on Instagram" is costing us visibility we've already paid to create. We need someone to close that gap, every week, without fail.

About Fabulr Studios

Fabulr Studios is a producer-led video and podcast studio based in West London. We offer studio hire, managed video production, post-production, photography, podcast recording, and livestreaming to startups, universities, science and tech companies, and corporate teams. We're growing, a second location is in the works. We run lean, so this role has real ownership from day one.



About the Role

Twelve months in, Fabulr's Instagram,
, and LinkedIn feeds will show a consistent, professional pulse of the studio's work, three posts a week, every week, without our founder having to remember to do it. You'll take raw footage, drafted captions, and content briefs and turn them into a live, on-brand social presence, chasing down what you need and keeping the calendar full even when the studio gets busy.



What You'll Do

? Own the posting calendar across Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — 3x/week minimum, scheduled and published on time

? Turn raw footage, photos, and draft captions (provided weekly) into finished, on-brand posts and Stories/Reels cutdowns

? Design supporting graphics in Canva using Fabulr's Brand Kit (colours, fonts, templates already set up)

? Monitor and respond to comments and DMs across all three platforms in a friendly, on-brand tone, flagging anything sensitive

? Chase the founder weekly (WhatsApp) for raw content if it hasn't been sent — this follow-up is part of the job, not an afterthought

? Maintain a simple content log so nothing posted or planned gets lost

? Flag underperforming or high-performing posts weekly with basic engagement notes

What We're Looking For

Required:

? Proven experience managing social media for a business (portfolio or examples required)

? Comfortable with basic video/photo editing for Stories and Reels (CapCut, InShot, Canva, or similar)

? Working knowledge of Canva, including using a Brand Kit

? Excellent written English and a friendly, professional tone

? Reliable self-starter — able to work async, chase down what's needed, and hit a fixed weekly cadence without close supervision

Preferred:

? Experience with a creative, video, or production-adjacent business

? Basic community management / customer service experience

? Familiarity with Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn scheduling tools (Buffer, or similar)

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Lead)
description:
About EETech

EETech is a dynamic technology company committed to delivering innovative digital commerce solutions. Our global team collaborates to create cutting-edge platforms that drive success for our clients. We value creativity, technical excellence, and a forward-thinking approach to solving complex challenges.



Job Overview

EETech is looking for a senior, highly technical QA Automation Engineer/Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our SaaS products and custom website implementations. This is not an entry- or mid-level role — we need someone who has already led QA initiatives, built automation strategy from the ground up, and can operate with minimal oversight. You'll be expected to bring proven expertise in test automation, drive process improvements, and mentor and guide QA practices across teams. This position is ideal for a self-directed, senior QA professional who thrives on solving complex quality challenges and shaping how a growing team approaches automation and testing.



Key Responsibilities

1/ Automation Strategy & Leadership

_Own and drive the QA automation strategy across web and mobile applications, working independently with minimal oversight.

_Design, develop, and maintain advanced automated test scripts and frameworks, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.

_Lead automation initiatives end-to-end — from tool evaluation and architecture decisions to rollout and adoption.



2/ QA Process Improvement

_Identify gaps in existing QA processes and implement measurable improvements across both SaaS products and custom website implementations.

_Establish and evolve QA best practices, standards, and testing strategy as the product and team scale.

_Bring a track record of having enacted similar process improvements in previous roles.



3/ Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

_Collaborate with development and product teams to define test requirements and ensure comprehensive coverage.

_Analyze test results, track issues, and drive defects to resolution promptly.



4/ Framework & Tool Enhancement

_Evaluate and implement new automation tools and best practices to enhance testing efficiency and accuracy.

_Maintain and evolve test suites in response to new feature development and changing product needs.



5/ Documentation & Reporting

_Create detailed test plans, test cases, and technical documentation to support automation efforts.

_Provide clear, concise reporting on test outcomes, quality metrics, and areas for improvement to stakeholders.



6/ Collaboration & Agile Practices

_Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

_Partner with cross-functional teams and, where needed, mentor junior QA tea
mbers.





Qualifications

1/ Experience

_7+ years of software QA experience, including 3–5 years in a senior or lead capacity.

_Demonstrated, hands-on experience leading QA automation initiatives with minimal supervision.

_Proven track record of enacting QA process improvements for both SaaS products and custom website implementations.

_Experience in a remote work environment with strong communication and time management skills.



2/ Technical Skills

_Deep proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Java.

_Strong, advanced experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Appium).

_Solid working knowledge of CI/CD tools and processes (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).



3/ Soft Skills

_Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.

_Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to guide QA direction and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.

_Comfortable operating autonomously and taking ownership of outcomes.



4/ Preferred Qualifications

_Experience with performance and load testing tools.

_Prior experience mentoring or leading a QA team.

_Knowledge of agile development methodologies and continuous testing practices.
