title: Engineering Support Virtual Assistant
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a tech-savvy and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our engineering team. This role increases engineering capacity by handling technical tool support, workflow automation, data management, and documentation, keeping our processes accurate, efficient, and ready for engineering review.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Engineering Workflow & Project Support

- Assist with internal project coordination, including status updates, follow-ups, and task tracking across active projects.

- Maintain internal project trackers, ensuring all tasks, submittals, and job files are current and properly labeled.

- Organize job files, inputs, calculations, and supporting documentation to ensure smooth engineering execution.

- Update and maintain project data across relevant platforms to keep records accurate and current.



2. Excel / Blockpad Transition Support

- Review and interpret existing Excel calculators and workbooks; map logic and structure into new engineering tools as directed.

- Recreate formulas, variable logic, and calculation flows in the target platform (e.g., Blockpad) under direct engineering guidance.

- Validate outputs against expected results and flag any discrepancies for engineering review.

- Provide occasional support for Blockpad-specific tasks as assigned.



3. Technical Operations & Automation Support

- Assist with workflow automation initiatives using Microsoft Power Automate and PowerShell.

- Support the development of reusable templates, standardized calculation sets, and structured file-routing logic.

- Identify and implement opportunities to reduce manual, repetitive steps across engineering workflows.



4. Communication & Documentation

- Provide clear, timely written updates on task progress, blockers, and next steps.

- Document internal processes and create simple guides or checklists for repeatable engineering tasks.

- Maintain accurate document control for design submittals, project logs, and client markups.



REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS

- Microsoft Excel — Advanced proficiency (VBA/Macros, formulas, pivot tables, structured workbooks, data validation)

- Power Automate / PowerShell — Working knowledge of workflow automation

- PDF markup & document control — Experience with submittal logs and project documentation

- Technical Writing — Ability to document processes clearly and concisely

- Communication — Excellent written and spoken English; responsive and proactive

- Hardware Specifications — Minimum of 16GB RAM, 250 GB storage, i7 Generation CPU or better.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Blockpad — Basic familiarity or willingness to learn on the job

- Background in engineering support, technical administration, or a related field

- Familiarity with structural engineering terminology, drawing organization, and design documentation

- Experience working with engineering platforms or calculation tools

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote environment

- Experience working with MathCad, 3D CAD software, or FEA Analysis software



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE MEANS

You help the Team stay focused on design and problem-solving — by keeping every project file organized, every automation workflow running, and every Excel/Blockpad calculation accurate and ready for engineering review.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
You own the list. Not the application that displays it, not the outreach that goes out from it — **the list itself**, and the machinery that keeps it accurate, ranked, and fresh.



Why this role exists



We're a bootstrapped B2B services company. Our sharpest buying signal is a public event that tells us an account has just moved in-market — a 
nt when what we sell becomes urgent rather than interesting.



That signal is buried in third-party data feeds. Millions of records a week. Maybe two thousand matter to us.



Right now, finding those two thousand is guesswork wearing a lab coat. A query someone wrote once, a filter nobody has re-tuned since, and a number at the end that nobody can defend.



Your work is to make that number defensible, then make it bigger without making it worse.





What you'll own



1. The signal pipeline

Third-party data feeds ? filtered ? deduplicated ? scored ? landed in our database. You design the queries. You tune the filters. You own the credit budget and every coverage tradeoff inside it.



2. The account universe

Not just the inbound flow — the full stock of companies that could ever buy from us. Industry association directories, technographic sources, licensing registries, public company web sources. Feeds are rented. This asset is ours permanently.



3. The scoring model

Not every signal is equal. An account in our size band that just triggered our buying event is gold. An account that looks identical on paper but structurally cannot buy is noise, and noise is expensive because Sales spends real hours on it. You build the logic that separates them, and you revise it when Sales tells you it's wrong.



4. Enrichment

Company ? decision-maker ? verified contact. You own the waterfall, the match rates, and the cost per usable contact.



5. The truth

When someone asks "how many qualified signals did we get last week," you answer with a number you can walk backward to source. That sounds small. It's the entire role.







What you need to have done before



- Built and maintained a real B2B list pipeline — pulling from APIs, cleaning, deduplicating, enriching, shipping to a CRM or sequencer. Not a one-off extract. Something that ran daily and that people depended on.

- SQL, fluently. You can write the query that finds the duplicates.

- Python or equivalent for API work, pagination, rate limits, retries, and scheduled tasks.

- Worked with firmographic, technographic, or intent data providers — Apollo, Clay, ZoomInfo, People Data Labs, Bright Data, or similar. You know that a vendor's coverage claim and your actual result are two different numbers.

- Deduplication and entity resolution. Same company, four name variants, three domains. You've solved this at scale before.

- Cost discipline. You've operated inside a credit budget and made tradeoffs rather than just asking for a bigger plan.



What helps



- Exposure to B2B services, real estate, or professional services verticals

- Clay, Instantly, Supabase, or comparable tooling

- Technographic tools (BuiltWith, Wappalyzer)

- Comfort writing a short memo that says "our number is wrong, and here's why"



What this role is not



- Not a scraper-builder. We buy data where buying beats building. You'll need judgment about which is which, and the default answer is usually "buy."

- Not a full-stack developer. Engineering builds the product. You own the data moving through it.

- Not an SDR. You don't send the outreach. You make sure it reaches the right people.

- Not set-and-forget. The ICP moves. Vendors quietly change coverage. Filters rot. If you want to build something once and walk away, this will frustrate you.



---



How we'll measure it



- Qualified signals per week — and whether that number survives an audit

- Precision — Tier A accounts Sales agrees were worth a call

- Cost per qualified account

- Freshness — hours from signal appearing to account landing

- Duplicate rate — trending down, every month

title: LLM / AI Agent Builder Needed for n8n + Internal AI Operating System
description:
LLM / AI Agent Builder Needed for n8n + Internal AI Operating System

title: US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper
description:
Job Title: US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-Time | Long-Term

Starting Rate: $6.00/hour (Increase after 90-day performance review)



We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to join our growing team. If you have hands-on experience with US tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting and enjoy working in an organized, systems-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.



Overview

We are looking for a dedicated US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper to support our accounting and tax operations. In this role, you will prepare individual, business, nonprofit, and state tax returns, maintain accurate financial records, and help ensure clients' books remain clean, compliant, and tax-ready throughout the year.

This position is ideal for someone who is accurate, dependable, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing multiple client engagements and meeting deadlines.



Job Details

As a US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper, you will manage tax preparation and bookkeeping responsibilities for multiple clients, maintain organized documentation, and support efficient accounting workflows. Your work will play a key role in ensuring compliance, financial accuracy, and a seamless tax preparation process for our clients.



What You'll Be Doing

Tax Preparation & Compliance

Prepare Individual Tax Returns (Form 1040) and related schedules.

Prepare Business Tax Returns, including Forms 1120, 1120S, and 1065.

Prepare Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, LLC, S Corporation, and C Corporation tax returns.

Prepare and file nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990-EZ and the full IRS Form 990, while ensuring compliance with nonprofit tax regulations.

Prepare and file state and franchise tax returns in accordance with applicable state requirements.

Review financial records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and tax readiness.

Identify missing information and communicate with clients or internal tea
mbers as needed.

Maintain organized digital tax workpapers and supporting documentation.



Bookkeeping & Financial Management

Perform bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online.

Categorize financial transactions accurately.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

Clean up and correct incomplete or inaccurate bookkeeping records when necessary.

Prepare monthly financial reports, including Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

Maintain accurate accounting records and ensure clients' books remain tax-ready throughout the year.



Data Entry & Administrative Support

Perform accurate data entry and document management.

Upload and organize client files using consistent naming conventions and folder structures.

Track assignments and meet internal deadlines.

Assist with administrative support related to accounting and tax operations.



Systems & Process Improvement

Follow established workflows, SOPs, and internal checklists.

Create or update process documentation when needed.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen internal processes, and reduce errors.



What You Bring to the Role

Proven experience preparing US Individual Income Tax Returns (Form 1040) and Business Tax Returns, including Sole Proprietorships, Partnerships, LLCs, S Corporations, and C Corporations.

Experience preparing and filing nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990. Experience with both Form 990-EZ and the full Form 990 is highly preferred, along with the ability to independently prepare nonprofit filings.

Experience preparing and filing state and franchise tax returns, with an understanding of franchise tax compliance requirements in one or more US states.

Strong bookkeeping experience, including monthly bookkeeping, account reconciliations, financial record maintenance, bookkeeping cleanups, and preparation of financial statements.

Experience managing bookkeeping and tax preparation for multiple clients or businesses simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

Proficiency with QuickBooks Online.

Experience using professional US tax software such as TaxSlayer, Drake, ProSeries, UltraTax, Lacerte, TaxAct Professional, or similar platforms.

Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.

Excellent time management with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines.

Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the team.

A commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work and maintaining client confidentiality.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with a US accounting, bookkeeping, CPA, or tax preparation firm.

Experience preparing multiple nonprofit tax returns annually.

Experience handling franchise tax filings for multiple states.

Strong understanding of GAAP-based bookkeeping principles.

Experience developing or improving accounting workflows and documentation.



What You Can Expect

Starting rate of $6.00/hour.

Performance review after 90 days with the opportunity for a pay increase.

Full-time, long-term remote position.

Stable workload and supportive team environment.

Opportunities to expand responsibilities based on performance.

A collaborative, process-driven workplace focused on continuous improvement and professional growth.



About the Company

We are a growing accounting and tax services company focused on providing accurate, reliable, and efficient support to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations. Our goal is to build a strong remote team that values integrity, accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement. We believe in building long-term relationships with both our clients and our tea
mbers while creating opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you have proven US tax preparation and bookkeeping experience and are looking for a long-term remote opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: CONTROLLER
description:
Recruit + Field is a premium qualitative market research recruiting firm. We recruit, screen, qualify, and place respondents — and we hold ourselves to a very high standard in everything we do. We're looking for a Controller who brings that same standard to our finances.



This is not a passive reporting role. We need someone who is genuinely invested in the financial health of this company — someone who reads the numbers, understands what they mean, asks hard questions, and flags issues before they become problems. You will have real visibility into the business and direct access to leadership.



The ideal candidate is equally comfortable processing an invoice and presenting a financial dashboard to leadership. You execute AP and AR personally, you watch the numbers closely, and you speak up when something is off. This is a do-it-yourself role with real organizational impact.



You will own the full financial operations cycle — including personally executing AP and AR transactions daily, month-end close, payroll coordination, reconciliations, and reporting — while also serving as the company's internal watchdog on spending, vendor costs, and financial accuracy. This role is equally about execution and oversight. You are in the weeds and watching the big picture at the same time.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



We are growing, and our financial infrastructure needs to keep pace. We need a single point of ownership for financial operations — someone who proactively monitors spending, holds vendors accountable, surfaces risks, and ensures that leadership always has an accurate, current picture of the company's financial health.



The right person will bring order, visibility, and vigilance to our finances and become a trusted partner to leadership.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Financial Vigilance & Expense Oversight

This is a top priority, not a secondary task. You will actively monitor company finances and flag anomalies proactively.

• Conduct regular expense audits — reviewing all company spend across QuickBooks, Ramp (corporate card platform), and vendor invoices

• Identify unusual charges, duplicate billing, unauthorized spend, or cost creep and escalate immediately to leadership

• Maintain and regularly review a vendor master list; flag redundant, lapsed, or overpriced vendor relationships

• Review all invoices before payment to verify accuracy, proper coding, and business justification

• Proactively surface cash flow risks, budget variances, and unusual trends — don't wait to be asked

• Build and maintain a recurring audit cadence (monthly and quarterly) for all expense categories



2. Accounts Payable & Receivable — Full Execution

This is a hands-on execution role, not a supervisory one. You will personally process AP and AR transactions daily — this is a core part of the job, not a delegation task.

Accounts Payable

• Review, code, and process all incoming vendor invoices — verifying accuracy, proper GL coding, and business justification before any payment is made

• Execute vendor payments including check runs, ACH transfers, and credit card settlements — ensuring nothing is paid late or paid incorrectly

• Manage all non-autopay items in QuickBooks Online from receipt through to cleared payment

• Advance payments when due and proactively manage payment timing to maintain vendor relationships and avoid late fees

• Collect W-9 / W-8 forms from all new vendors before first payment is issued; maintain vendor records accurately in QuickBooks Online

• Reconcile vendor statements against QuickBooks records and resolve discrepancies directly with vendors

• Oversee 1099 preparation and filing at year-end, including respondent 1099 reporting in coordination with the ops team

Accounts Receivable

• Generate and send client invoices accurately and on time — ensuring invoices match agreed project scopes and terms

• Record and apply all incoming payments in QuickBooks Online promptly and accurately

• Monitor outstanding receivables and proactively follow up on any past-due balances — escalating to leadership when needed

• Maintain clean AR aging — flag any overdue accounts or collection risks early

• Reconcile client payments against invoices and resolve any billing discrepancies directly with clients or internal project leads

• Keep bank feeds updated and ensure all transactions are assigned consistent, accurate accounting codes



3. Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

• Execute month-end close — reconciliations, journal entries, bank/credit card statement reconciliations

• Prepare monthly financial package: P&L, cash flow summary, balance sheet snapshot, and budget vs. actuals

• Generate dashboard-ready reports for leadership that are clear, accurate, and actionable — not just data dumps

• Attend and contribute to monthly financial review meetings; own follow-up action items

• Review weekly accounting accuracy and resolve variances promptly



4. Payroll Coordination

• Oversee payroll processing in coordination with the payroll processor (Human Resources) and QuickBooks Online payroll

• Manage benefits coordination, department/role changes, and new hire payroll setup

• Ensure payroll accuracy and flag discrepancies before they are processed



5. Quarterly Financial Management

• Conduct comprehensive reviews of budgets, forecasts, and profitability metrics

• Lead quarterly vendor contract reviews to identify savings opportunities

• Prepare quarterly financial statements and present clear, actionable insights to leadership

• Ensure compliance with quarterly tax filing requirements; liaise with external CPA as needed

• Run scenario analyses, burn reports, and cash flow projections as needed



6. Process Improvement & Documentation

• Identify inefficiencies in financial and operational workflows and implement practical improvements

• Document and maintain SOPs for all key financial processes

• Leverage tools — QuickBooks Online, Ramp, and others — to their full capability

• Partner with Sales, HR, and Operations to ensure financial processes support business goals



7. Financial Support to the VP of Qualitative Research & CEO

While this role reports directly to the VP of Qualitative Research, the Controller also serves as a financial resource to the CEO — providing visibility, analysis, and insights that support company-level decision-making.

• Keep the VP of Qualitative Research informed with accurate, timely financial summaries and flag anything requiring attention or escalation

• Provide the CEO with financial data, reporting, and analysis as needed — including profitability summaries, cash flow snapshots, and budget vs. actuals

• Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and scenario models as requested by the VP or CEO

• Attend leadership meetings as needed and contribute clear financial context — translating numbers into plain language

• Proactively surface financial trends, risks, or opportunities to leadership rather than waiting to be asked

• Support budget planning, goal-setting, and financial forecasting in partnership with the VP and CEO



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first 90 days, a successful Controller will:

• Have fully taken over AP and AR — all invoices processed, payments advanced, and client invoices going out cleanly and on time

• Complete a full audit of current vendor spend and surface any flags to leadership

• Establish a clean, consistent month-end close process

• Deliver a financial dashboard that leadership can actually use

• Have caught at least one thing that wasn't being caught before



Ongoing, you will be measured on financial accuracy, the timeliness and quality of reporting, the proactiveness of your issue-flagging, and your genuine partnership with the VP of Qualitative Research and CEO.



CORE COMPETENCIES



• Financial stewardship — you treat company money with care and take personal ownership of financial health

• Proactive communication — you surface issues early, not after the fact

• Attention to detail — you notice things others miss

• Technical proficiency — advanced QuickBooks Online; experience with Ramp or similar expense platforms

• Analytical thinking — you understand what numbers mean, not just what they say

• Process discipline — you build systems that prevent problems, not just respond to them

• Cross-functional collaboration — you work well with non-finance people and translate financial data clearly



SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS



Education

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or a related field (required)



Experience

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a controller or senior accounting role, including at least 5 recent years with US-based companies. Strong understanding of US finance, tax, and accounting practices is essential.

• Minimum 2 years working cross-functionally with non-finance teams

• Demonstrated experience with expense auditing, vendor management, and financial controls

• Experience in a small business or startup environment strongly preferred — you are comfortable being the only finance person in the room



Technical Requirements

• Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (non-negotiable)

• Experience with corporate card/expense platforms (Ramp experience a plus)

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for reporting and analysis

• Comfortable with remote tools and virtual collaboration



WORK REQUIREMENTS



• Must be available to work and communicate during US Eastern Time business hours

• High proficiency in written and spoken English required for all communications

• Remote position — must be self-directed and reliable without in-person oversight



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To be considered for this position, please begin your submission or proposal with the sentence: "I AM HUMAN." Applications that do not include this phrase will not be reviewed.



In your cover letter or proposal, please include a brief description of a time you identified a financial issue — billing error, cost anomaly, unauthorized spend, or similar — that others had missed, and describe the steps you took to resolve it. This is the most important thing we want to understand about you.

title: DTC / E-commerce Ad Video Editor
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.



Trial task: 



If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

title: Senior Business Systems & Process Improvement Specialist
description:
Senior Business Systems & Process Improvement Specialist 



Remote | Part-Time (20+ hrs/week initially, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role for the right candidate.) 

$7–$12 USD/hour (depending on experience)

Performance Bonuses Available



About Us



We're a premium Australian service-based business that is growing quickly and continuously improving the way we operate.



Our goal isn't simply to become busier.



Our goal is to build a business that runs exceptionally well.



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys creating order from chaos, improving workflows, identifying inefficiencies, documenting business knowledge and building systems that allow a business to scale.



This isn't about simply documenting what already exists.



We're looking for someone who can analyse how our business operates, identify opportunities for improvement, recommend better ways of doing things and help build a business that becomes more efficient, consistent and less reliant on the business owner.



If you genuinely enjoy improving businesses, we'd love to hear from you.



---



About The Role



This is not  an administrative position.



This is  not  a customer service role.



This is a  Business Systems & Process Improvement  role.



You'll work closely with the business owner to analyse how the business currently operates, identify bottlenecks, improve workflows, document processes and continuously recommend better ways of operating.



You'll often receive rough ideas, verbal explanations or existing documents and transform them into clear, scalable systems that others can easily follow.



We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait to be told what to improve.



We want someone who naturally identifies problems, asks thoughtful questions, challenges inefficient processes and enjoys finding better ways of doing things.



If something can be improved, we want you to identify it.



If something can be documented, we want you to document it.



If something can be simplified, we want you to simplify it.



If something can be automated, we want you to recommend it.



---



Your Responsibilities



Examples of work include:



* Creating detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Improving existing business processes

* Building process maps and workflow documentation

* Creating decision trees

* Developing operational standards

* Creating quality assurance checklists

* Reviewing existing systems and identifying inefficiencies

* Improving internal documentation

* Standardising business processes

* Building onboarding documentation

* Creating staff training manuals

* Organising business knowledge into structured documentation

* Identifying repetitive tasks suitable for automation

* Recommending software and workflow improvements

* Helping develop scalable operational systems

* Ensuring documentation remains current as the business evolves



---



We're Looking For Someone Who...



* Loves creating systems

* Enjoys improving businesses

* Notices inefficiencies quickly

* Thinks logically

* Can see the "big picture" without losing attention to detail

* Writes exceptionally clear documentation

* Can simplify complicated processes

* Takes initiative

* Can independently identify opportunities for improvement

* Enjoys solving operational problems

* Asks thoughtful questions before making assumptions

* Is comfortable challenging existing processes when there's a better way

* Is comfortable receiving constructive feedback

* Has excellent written English

* Enjoys continuous improvement



---



Experience We'd Love



Experience in any of the following areas would be highly regarded:



* Business systems

* Business process improvement

* SOP creation

* Operations improvement

* Process documentation

* Workflow optimisation

* Business process mapping

* Knowledge management

* Continuous improvement

* Operational excellence

* AI-assisted productivity



We're currently using:



* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail & Calendar)

* Slack

* WhatsApp

* Zoom

* Fathom AI Notetaker

* Timely CRM

* Wix

* MightyText

* ChatGPT



Over time we'll also be introducing additional systems, including Zapier for business automations and Loom for training documentation.



Experience with these platforms is highly regarded but not essential.



If you've worked with other workflow, documentation, automation or project management software, we'd love to hear about it.



We're much more interested in  how you think  than the specific software you've used.



---



What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months you'll be helping us:



* Build an organised business knowledge base

* Improve existing workflows

* Reduce operational bottlenecks

* Create documentation that allows staff to work independently

* Increase consistency across the business

* Identify opportunities for automation

* Continuously recommend improvements that save time, reduce errors and improve efficiency



---



Why You'll Love Working With Us



* Flexible working hours

* Long-term position

* Opportunity for increased hours as the business grows

* Performance bonuses

* You'll have genuine influence over how the business operates

* Your ideas will be heard, valued and implemented

* We genuinely encourage continuous improvement rather than maintaining the status quo



For an exceptional candidate with demonstrated expertise in Business Systems & Process Improvement, we are open to discussing a higher hourly rate.



---



How To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



 1.  Tell us about a business process you significantly improved. What was the problem, what changes did you make, and what was the outcome?



 2.  Have you ever created SOPs, operational manuals or business systems? Please provide examples.



 3.  Tell us about the largest business improvement project you've worked on.



 4.  Imagine you join a business with almost no documented systems. Where would you begin, and why?



 5.  Tell us about a time you identified a problem before anyone else noticed it.



 6.  How do you ensure documentation remains accurate as a business evolves?



 7.  Describe a project you're most proud of and why.



 8.  What AI tools do you regularly use to improve your productivity and quality of work?



 9.  Have you ever recommended or implemented business automations? If so, please describe what you built and the impact it had.



 10.  Business continuity is important to us. Please describe your contingency plan for unexpected events such as:



* Internet outages

* Power outages

* Computer failure

* Severe weather

* Any other disruption that could prevent you from working



We're interested in the actual system you have in place, not simply what you would do. Please include any backup equipment, internet connections, alternative work locations and examples of when you've successfully used your contingency plan.



 11.  Why do you believe you'd be a great fit for this role?



 12.  Finally, include the word  Blueprint  as the first word of your application so we know you've read the entire job advertisement.



 13.  What questions would you ask us during your first week to better understand how our business operates? 



Finally, to demonstrate your attention to detail, please include the word "Blueprint" as the very first word of your application. Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.

title: CRM Developer/Builder
description:

Work description

We're a US-based performance marketing agency looking for a CRM Specialist who can build our CRM infrastructure from the ground up and own our outbound lead generation and
 marketing efforts.



This is not a "set up a tool and hand it off" role. We need someone who can select the right CRM platform for our business, build it out, and then run it day to day. That means building pipelines, automations,
 sequences, lead lists, and reporting, then continuously optimizing based on what's working.



If you've built a CRM system from scratch for an agency or B2B company and have a track record of generating leads through cold outreach and
 campaigns, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing



CRM Build and Management

Evaluate and recommend the right CRM platform for a growing marketing agency. Build the entire CRM from scratch: pipelines, deal stages, contact management, lead scoring, tagging, and workflow automations. Maintain and optimize the system on an ongoing basis. Ensure data hygiene and accuracy across all records. Create dashboards and reports so leadership has visibility into pipeline health and campaign performance.



Cold
 Outreach

Build and execute cold
 outreach campaigns targeting potential clients. Research and build targeted prospect lists based on ideal client profiles. Write outreach sequences that get responses, not just opens. Manage follow-up cadences and track response rates. Continuously test and refine subject lines, messaging, and targeting.



Lead Generation

Develop and manage a lead generation system that consistently fills the pipeline. Identify and qualify leads through outbound strategies. Set up lead capture workflows that move prospects from cold to warm to booked. Track and report on lead volume, conversion rates, and cost per lead.



 Marketing

Plan, build, and send
 campaigns including newsletters, nurture sequences, re-engagement campaigns, and promotional
s. Segment audiences and personalize messaging based on where contacts are in the funnel. Set up automated
 workflows triggered by user behavior or pipeline stage. Monitor deliverability, open rates, click rates, and conversions. Manage list health, including unsubscribes, bounces, and suppression lists.



What We're Looking For



Hands-on experience building a CRM from scratch, not just using one someone else set up. Strong knowledge of at least one major CRM platform (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar). We're open to your recommendation on the right tool for us. Proven experience running cold
 outreach campaigns that generated real results (share numbers if you can). Experience with
 marketing platforms and automation tools. Understanding of deliverability best practices: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation management. Ability to write clear, concise outreach and marketing copy that sounds human, not templated. Experience building lead lists and prospect research. Strong reporting skills. You should be comfortable pulling data and telling us what's working and what's not. Self-starter who can own the entire function without being managed step by step. Agency or B2B experience is strongly preferred.



Bonus Points



Experience with tools like Instantly, Lemlist, Apollo, Smartlead, Hunter, or similar outbound platforms. Experience integrating CRM with other tools (Slack, Google Workspace, ad platforms, analytics). Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach as a complement to
. Experience building SOPs and documenting processes for future tea
mbers.



Details



Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, aligned with US Eastern Time business hours.

Type: Long-term contract with potential to grow.

Start: As soon as possible.



How to Apply:



Which CRM platform would you recommend for a growing marketing agency with approximately 20 clients, and why?

Describe a CRM you built from scratch. What was the business, what did you build, and what was the result?

Share one cold
 outreach campaign you ran. What was the target audience, what was your approach, and what were the response/conversion numbers?



Applications that don't answer these three questions will not be reviewed.

title: WordPress Performance Engineer (Revenue-Focused)
description:
The Opportunity:

We are a specialised WordPress performance agency based in Brighton, UK. We don’t do design or generic maintenance. We perform Technical Surgery on WordPress sites to stop revenue hemorrhaging. We are scaling rapidly and looking for an elite Performance Engineer to take full ownership of our "5-Stage Performance Triage" process.



The Mission:

You will take a raw client site, run it through our proprietary 5-Stage Triage, identify the bottlenecks, and deliver a client-ready report that translates "technical debt" into "revenue recovered."



Your 5-Stage Workflow (The System You Own):



1 - Core Health Audit: Deep-dive into server response, database bloat, and PHP inefficiencies.

2 - Asset Load Analysis: Identifying bloat, render-blocking resources, and plugin misuse.

3 - Revenue Leak Mapping: Connecting performance metrics directly to user behavior and conversion drop-offs.



The "Fix-It" Roadmap: Creating a clear, prioritized, and actionable strategy.



Execution & Validation: Executing the surgery and proving the results.



Your Role:



Total Ownership: I hand you a paid diagnostic triage order. You own the audit, the report, the client-facing communication, and the final execution. No hand-holding.



Timeline Expectations: The standard turnaround for the initial audit is 3 days, though faster delivery is always preferred. You will be provided with clear timeframes for both auditing and execution.



Revenue Literacy: You must be able to explain to a non-technical business owner exactly how much money they are losing due to site speed—and exactly how your fix will stop the leak.



Deep-Tech Execution: You are a master of the WordPress engine. You fix the root cause, not the symptoms.



We are targeting 2 client reports per week immediately, with a clear path to scale as our outreach engine expands. We are looking for someone who can own this delivery and eventually help us train and manage additional capacity as the agency grows.



The "Proof of Skill" (Paid Trial):

We don't hire based on resumes. We hire based on output. If shortlisted, you will be paid to conduct a "Performance Triage" on a sample site. We want to see how you identify the 3 biggest revenue leaks and how you present your "fix-it" surgery plan.



Must-Haves:



The "Owner" Mindset: You treat every client site like it’s your own business. You don't need a manager; you need a target.



Deep-Tech Expertise: You can read and write PHP, optimize MySQL queries, and configure server-side caching.



Business Literacy: You can turn technical logs into a professional, persuasive, client-facing PDF.



How to Apply:



The Evidence: Send a link to one site you have optimized. Tell me the "Before" vs "After" metrics, and explain the business outcome (e.g., "Conversion rate increased because we cut the TTI by 2 seconds").



The Logic: Why is "Performance Engineering" the only work you want to do?



The Subject Line: You must use the subject line "PERFORMANCE ENGINEER - [Your Name]"

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Odoo Solutions Architect & Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a senior-level Odoo Systems & Process Consultant to help us audit, map and improve complex Odoo workflows across Inventory, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Sales, CRM, Helpdesk and eCommerce.



This is not a simple admin role. We need someone who can understand real operational processes, identify bottlenecks, challenge inefficient workflows, and design practical Odoo solutions that make day-to-day work easier for our team.



Our workflows include multi-stage manufacturing and subcontracting, product variants, raw material resupply to subcontractors, receiving coated and component products, final assembly BoMs, and ensuring Odoo remains aligned with a simple and intuitive Shopify customer ordering experience.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Map and document existing Odoo workflows across Sales, Inventory, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Subcontracting and Customer Support.

• Review complex MRP, BoM, subcontracting and inventory flows and recommend improved system architecture.

• Design streamlined workflows for raw material resupply, subcontractor/coater management, component receipt, final assembly production, labour BoMs and packaging BoMs.

• Simplify product setup using the appropriate combination of product variants, attributes, configuration templates, automated actions and custom development.

• Improve order flexibility so sales users can amend orders after processing without creating inventory, purchasing or manufacturing issues.

• Help align complex back-end processes with a simple and user-friendly Shopify eCommerce experience.

• Document recommended workflows clearly so our internal team can understand, maintain and develop them further.

• Where appropriate, implement or specify Odoo Studio changes, automated actions, server actions, custom fields, views, reporting filters and other user-focused improvements.



EXAMPLES OF ODOO PROCESSES WE NEED TO IMPROVE



• A cleaner product creation process for configurable products with repetitive variant configurations, reducing lengthy manual setup.

• A robust way to handle bespoke and non-returnable products on quotations and orders.

• Better visibility of customer communication preferences within CRM.

• Improved links between Helpdesk Tickets, CRM Opportunities and Sales Orders.

• Inventory alerts and location-based stock counting improvements.

• Enhanced change logs, margin visibility and Shopify-related sales fields.



OUR CURRENT ODOO ENVIRONMENT



We have already completed several successful Odoo customisations, including:



• Linking Helpdesk Tickets to Sales Orders.

• Creating Sales Orders directly from Helpdesk Tickets.

• Linking Helpdesk Tickets with CRM Opportunities.



We are now looking to move into more advanced process architecture around MRP, subcontracting, inventory management and eCommerce integration.



We are also preparing for a future upgrade from Odoo 17 to Odoo 20. This will require thorough review and testing to ensure any existing functionality that may break during the upgrade is identified, documented and resolved before deployment.



Previous upgrades have been disruptive to business operations, so a key objective of this role is to help us:



• Map existing processes and customisations.

• Identify potential upgrade risks.

• Ensure workflows continue working as expected after the upgrade.

• Document any process changes.

• Train users on new or modified workflows before any upgrade takes place.



ADVANCED TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



We operate Odoo Online and prefer standard Odoo functionality wherever possible. However, when a business requirement cannot be achieved using standard functionality, the successful candidate must be confident developing solutions using:



• Odoo Studio

• Automated Actions

• Server Actions

• Python



You should be able to assess a business problem and determine whether it should be solved using standard Odoo functionality, Studio customisation, automation, Python development, or a combination of these approaches.



PYTHON & CUSTOMISATION EXPERIENCE



This is not a purely functional consultant role.



You must be able to demonstrate real examples of Python-based Odoo customisations that you have implemented.



We do not mind whether the code was written entirely by you, created with AI assistance, adapted from existing examples, or developed using tools such as Microsoft Copilot. What matters is that you:



• Understand what the code does.

• Can explain the logic clearly.

• Can troubleshoot and maintain it.

• Can modify and improve it when required.

• Can deliver reliable, working solutions.



Please provide examples involving:



• Python-based workflow automation.

• Odoo Studio customisations.

• Automated Actions and Server Actions.

• Complex field calculations.

• Inventory, manufacturing, procurement or sales workflow improvements.



EFFICIENCY MATTERS



We value simplicity and maintainability.



The best solution is not always the one with the most code.



We expect candidates to:



• Challenge unnecessary complexity.

• Use standard Odoo functionality wherever possible.

• Use Odoo Studio before resorting to custom code where appropriate.

• Write concise, efficient and maintainable code when development is genuinely required.

• Avoid creating hundreds of lines of custom code to solve problems that could be addressed through configuration or standard workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience as an Odoo Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Solutions Architect or Senior Odoo Developer.

• Expert understanding of Odoo Manufacturing (MRP), Inventory, Purchasing, Sales and Subcontracting workflows.

• Strong experience mapping complex operational processes into practical ERP workflows.

• Comfortable using Odoo Studio, Automated Actions, Server Actions, Custom Fields, Views and workflow automation.

• Able to explain complex systems clearly to non-technical users.

• Excellent written English and documentation skills.

• Able to work independently, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions when improvements can be made.



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience with Shopify or other eCommerce integrations.

• Experience with Odoo Online and Odoo 17.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, fabrication, procurement, construction supply, distribution or highly configurable product businesses.

• Knowledge of Python, XML and QWeb development.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• A summary of your experience with Odoo MRP, Inventory, Purchasing and Subcontracting.

• Two or three examples of complex Odoo workflows you have mapped, redesigned or implemented.

• At least two examples of Python-based Odoo customisations, including:

  - The business problem.

  - Why standard Odoo functionality was insufficient.

  - The solution implemented.

  - Approximate amount of code required.

  - The business outcome achieved.

• Your hourly rate in USD.

• Your availability per week.

• Confirmation that you are comfortable working on a pay-as-you-go / project-based basis.



APPLICATION QUESTION



Describe a situation where you deliberately chose a standard Odoo solution instead of writing custom Python code. Why was this the better business decision?

title: Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant / Spanish & English
description:
West Orange Nephrology is a kidney care clinic located in Winter Garden, Florida. Our team of experienced nephrologists provides personalized care across diagnostics, dialysis, laboratory services, and patient education. About the role

You will support our providers and clinical staff by keeping the clinical day running smoothly and scribing for providers. Your responsibilities range from flagging urgent lab results to preparing charts before appointments and checking patients in and out for virtual visits. This role requires strong medical knowledge, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both patients and clinical staff.  MUST SPEAK SPANISH AND ENGLISH!!!



What you'll be doing

You will monitor and flag critical lab values to the appropriate provider in a timely manner, prepare and prep patient charts ahead of scheduled clinic visits, contact pharmacies to process and follow up on medication refill requests, and communicate with clinic staff to relay provider instructions and patient updates. You will also check patients in and out for telehealth visits, maintain accurate documentation in the EHR system, and ensure all tasks are completed in compliance with HIPAA regulations.



Who we're looking for

We need someone with experience as a medical assistant, clinical coordinator, or in a similar US healthcare role. Familiarity with nephrology, chronic disease management, or specialty clinic workflows is a strong plus. You should be comfortable reading and interpreting lab results, experienced with EHR or EMR systems such as eClinicalWorks, Athena, or Epic, and able to manage multiple tasks during a busy clinic day. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and HIPAA training are all required.



Important

This position supports a US-based medical practice. US medical office or clinical experience is required. Candidates without US healthcare experience will not be considered.



How to apply

Send a short introduction about yourself and your clinical background. Please answer this question: "What EHR systems have you worked with, and what does your experience with chart prep or lab monitoring look like?" Applications that skip this question will not be reviewed.

title: GHL Automation & Webinar Specialist
description:
We need a GoHighLevel specialist who lives inside GHL the way most people live inside their
. This is not a generalist VA role with GHL as one of many tools. GHL is your primary tool, your domain, and the thing you are hired to own.



You will be responsible for building and maintaining automations, managing webinar sequences, handling campaign data, and supporting incoming communications. You will also be expected to use AI tools — specifically Claude — to build dashboards, documents, and internal tools without needing a developer.



If you need someone to explain to you what a trigger or workflow branch is, this is not the right role. If you can build a complex multi-step automation from scratch and explain every decision you made, keep reading.



What you will own

GHL automations and workflows - Build, manage, and troubleshoot automations across pipelines, campaigns, and sequences - Design and maintain workflows for lead intake, follow-up, booking, and no-show handling - Integrate GHL with external tools (Zapier, Make, Google Sheets, Stripe, Zoom, and others) - Audit existing automations and improve them proactively — not only when something breaks



Webinar operations - Set up and manage weekly webinar sequences inside GHL from registration to post-event follow-up - Manage Zoom Webinar (or WebinarJam) — scheduling, reminders, attendee management, recordings - Monitor automation sequences tied to webinar campaigns and fix issues in real time - Track registration rates, show rates, and engagement — report on what the data says



Campaign management and data - Build and manage SMS and
 campaigns inside GHL - Track campaign performance: open rates, click rates, reply rates, conversion metrics - Pull data from GHL, organize it, and put it somewhere the team can actually use it - Flag what is working and what is not — you are not just executing, you are reading the results



Inbound communications - Handle a portion of incoming messages — leads, client inquiries, general support - You are not the primary support person, but you will be expected to respond professionally and on time - Escalate when needed, resolve when you can



AI-assisted building - Use Claude and Claude Code to build dashboards, internal tracking tools, SOPs, and reports without needing a developer - You do not need to be a software engineer, but you need to know how to build with AI — and produce output that is actually useful and runs



What we need to see from you

GoHighLevel — You have used it as your primary tool for at least 3 years. You know automations, pipelines, campaigns, forms, funnels, calendars, and workflows inside out. You have built complex multi-branch automations, not just simple drip sequences. You know when something is wrong before someone tells you.



Webinar experience — You have personally set up and managed live webinar sequences. Not supervised someone who did it. You know how to build the landing page, the registration form, the confirmation sequence, the reminder sequence, the post-event follow-up, and the no-show re-engagement. You have run something live and fixed problems in real time.



Data and reporting — You track things. You know what the numbers mean. You do not just pull a report and hand it to someone — you tell them what it says and what to do about it.



AI tools — You use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools daily. You have used AI to build something — a dashboard, a tracker, a document, a workflow. Familiarity with Claude Code is a strong plus. You can show us what you have made.



Communication — Your written English is professional. You respond quickly. You flag problems before they become bigger problems. You do not go quiet.



What we do not want

Someone who lists GHL as a skill but uses it for basic pipeline management

Someone who needs a checklist to set up a webinar sequence

Someone who reports data without interpreting it

Someone who uses AI as a spell-checker rather than a builder

Someone who needs significant hand-holding on technical setup

Someone who treats this like a job they maintain rather than a function they own

Application instructions

Do not send a generic application. We will not read it.



Answer these three questions in your application. Keep it direct and specific — no more than a few sentences each.



Describe the most complex automation you have built in GHL. What triggered it, what were the branches, and what was the outcome?



Walk us through how you would set up a full webinar sequence inside GHL — from registration page to post-webinar follow-up. Be specific.



Show us something you have built using AI. Link to it, screenshot it, or describe it in detail. What was the problem, what did you build, and what was the result?



Applications without answers to these three questions will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.



Trial task: 
/p/drippl/Video-Editor-Trial-Task-341f520455d9802bab7ae1594d83abe4?source=copy_link



If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

title: [URGENT] Part-Time Executive Assistant / Operations Manager for Premium Tai Chi Academy (LA-Based)
description:
About Us:

Chen Bing Taiji Academy USA (CBTA USA) is a highly prestigious, premium martial arts institution based in Los Angeles, California, with over 23 years of rich history in the United States. 



We are proudly recognized as the most authentic Tai Chi academy in Los Angeles, holding a direct lineage from Chenjiagou, China—the historical birthplace of Tai Chi (Taijiquan). We pride ourselves on cultural preservation, elite-level instruction, and professional business operations.



Under the direct leadership of Master Bosco Baek, we are seeking a highly capable, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant / Operations Manager to streamline our administrative, payroll, and digital marketing workflows.



Key Responsibilities (Prioritized):



1. Zen Planner Administration & Kiosk Setup Support (Top Priority)

- Manage and monitor student profiles, attendance, and membership renewals via Zen Planner.

- Proactively resolve failed/declined credit card payments and communicate with members professionally using our templates.

- Future Kiosk Project: Research and assist the owner in deploying an iPad Attendance Kiosk at the gym entrance using Zen Planner’s official documentation and setup guides.



2. High-Quality Video Editing & Social Media Management (Weekly)

- Manage and schedule posts on our
 Business Page, Instagram, and TikTok (at least once a week).

- Content Creation: We do NOT use basic/amateur editing tools like CapCut or Canva. You must edit raw class and training footage (provided by the owner) into cinematic, high-quality Reels, Shorts, and TikTok videos using Adobe Premiere and advanced AI-driven video tools (such as Seyedance, Luma, or Runway).

- Monitor and professionally respond to routine client inquiries on Yelp, Google My Business, and social media DMs to book introductory classes.



3. Bi-Weekly Payroll & Monthly Newsletters

- Gusto Bi-Weekly Payroll: Every two weeks, collect working hours/classes from our part-time instructors, prepare the payroll run in Gusto, and submit it for the owner’s final approval.

- Monthly Newsletter: Draft and distribute a high-quality monthly community newsletter using GoDaddy to share academy updates, traditional Tai Chi history, and events.



4. Eventbrite Management (Monthly)

- Set up, manage, and promote our monthly workshops, seminars, or community events on Eventbrite.



Qualifications & Requirements:

- Deep respect and passion for traditional martial arts (experience or background in martial arts/gym operations is highly preferred).

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and next-generation AI video generation/editing platforms (Seyedance, etc.). Capable of delivering cinematic, professional-grade social media content.

- Experience with Zen Planner (or similar martial arts/gym software like Mindbody, PushPress) is a significant advantage.

- Hands-on experience with US payroll systems, specifically Gusto (understanding bi-weekly payroll runs for 1099/W2).

- Impeccable, professional written and spoken English.

- High level of ownership, self-motivation, and absolute trustworthiness.



How to Apply (Strictly Required):

To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



1. A brief summary of your professional experience with Zen Planner (or gym software), Gusto, and high-end video editing (Premiere/AI tools).

2. A link to your portfolio demonstrating high-quality video editing projects (raw vs. edited clips).

3. A 1-minute video introduction (using Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube link) speaking in English. Introduce yourself, highlight your skills, and share why you are interested in working with an authentic, direct-lineage Tai Chi academy.



*Applications without a portfolio and a video introduction link will be automatically rejected.*
