title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Executive Assistant — ChelsiJo.Co | Remote | Full-Time**



**About Us**



ChelsiJo.Co is a Christian, women-led online coaching company that helps women build a life and business operating system so they can scale without overwhelm. We are a close-knit, mission-driven team looking for someone who shares that heart and wants to be part of something meaningful long-term.



**The Role**



This is a full-time, remote Executive Assistant position (1099 independent contractor) reporting to the Operations Manager, with responsibilities that touch every department in the company — Operations, Marketing, Sales, Student Success, and Web/Tech/Design.



This is not a task-execution role alone. We're looking for someone who takes true ownership of our operating system and processes — someone who audits how things are working, catches problems before they become bigger issues, and brings solutions rather than just flagging concerns. You'll follow written SOPs exactly as documented, but you'll also be trusted and expected to identify where our systems are breaking down and proactively fix them, reporting your findings and recommendations to the Operations Manager.



This role includes daily voice communication with the team (e.g. Voxer) and a monthly on-camera video check-in, so strong spoken English is required for both daily and on-screen communication.



We teach our own students a specific method for running their business operating system. You'll need to be willing to learn that method deeply and operate within our standards, not just apply general best practices from past roles.



**Hours:** Monday through Friday, US Eastern Time, 8 hours/day (start time between 5:00–8:00 AM EST), 40 hours/week. As a 1099 contractor, you'll be responsible for your own taxes, equipment, and benefits; this role does not include employee benefits such as health insurance or paid time off.



**Compensation:** $8–15/hour based on experience (approx. $1,387–$2,600/month, $16,640–$31,200/year)



**What You Will Do**



*Ownership & Systems Auditing*



- Actively audit our operating systems and processes for gaps, inefficiencies, or breakdowns

- Bring identified problems to the Operations Manager along with proposed solutions 

- Take accountability for outcomes, not just task completion

- Learn and operate within ChelsiJo.Co's proprietary operating syste
thod



*Executive & Cross-Departmental Support*



- Report to the CEO and Operations Manager, managing competing priorities across both

- Support Marketing, Sales, Student Success, and Web/Tech/Design teams with operational and administrative needs

- Execute written SOPs exactly as documented — flagging ambiguity rather than improvising

- Communicate daily via voice with the team and participate in a monthly on-camera video check-in



*Sales Support*



- Sales pipeline lead tasks, including outreach to leads who need to complete their application

- Support tracking and reporting on ad campaign performance in coordination with Marketing

- Assist with sales admin tasks tied to failed payments and student billing



*Core Operations*



- Inbox Management, Calendar Management, Operation System Oversight

- Podcast/YouTube Workflow, Content Calendar

- Publicity Pipeline & Interview Management

- KPI Tracking and Reporting

- Failed Payment Recovery

- Student Re-Engagement & Student Success Admin support



**Who We Are Looking For**



- 4+ years of Executive Assistant, Operations, or high-accountability administrative experience. Ideally including experience improving or auditing processes, not just following them

- Highly proficient in Go High Level and Notion. This is not a "willing to learn" skill, it's a requirement

- Demonstrated ability to follow a written process exactly, without deviation or missed steps. This will be tested during the interview process

- Strong, clear spoken English. Comfortable with daily voice communication and a monthly on-camera check-in

- A self-starter who identifies problems and proposes solutions, rather than waiting to be told what's wrong

- Experience with digital ad platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads, or similar) preferred

- Comfortable working directly with executive leadership and exercising discretion with sensitive information

- Proficient in Calendly; comfortable learning MeisterTask

- Willing to learn and fully adopt ChelsiJo.Co's specific operating syste
thod

- Highly dependable and detail-oriented

- Seeking a long-term, full-time role — not a short-term or transitional position

- Able to work full-time US Eastern hours consistently, Monday–Friday

description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:


com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.

JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via
, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here:

title: Greeting Card Researcher & AI Designer (Ideogram, ChatGPT, Google Flow)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized and creative Greeting Card Researcher and AI Designer to join our team. In this role, you will own the entire lifecycle of our print-on-demand greeting card pipeline — from scouting profitable occasions and trending sentiments to generating high-quality designs using the latest AI creative tools, and keeping our growing asset library perfectly organized.



If you know how to spot winning trends in the stationery market and can seamlessly blend AI-generated art into print-ready card layouts, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities



Niche & Trend Research: Conduct daily research to identify profitable, low-competition occasions, trending sentiments, and visual styles (e.g., niche birthdays, holidays, humor, and specific life events).



AI-Driven Design Generation: Use AI platforms — specifically Ideogram, ChatGPT, and Google Flow — to generate, remix, and refine front-cover artwork and interior graphics.



Prompt Engineering: Craft highly specific text prompts to maintain style consistency and ensure the generated artwork translates perfectly to physical paper goods.



Asset Organization: Act as the librarian for our design assets. You will name, tag, and organize files in bulk (front, inside, and back cover assets), ensuring our workflow remains frictionless from generation to final upload.



Quality & Compliance: Review all outputs and written sentiments for copyright and trademark compliance before they are cleared for the upload queue.



Requirements



Proven Market Experience: A strong track record of spotting winning trends and understanding consumer buying habits in the stationery, greeting card, or print-on-demand market.



AI Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience generating production-ready art with Ideogram and ChatGPT. You must also be proficient in using Google Flow to generate, edit, and refine visual assets.



Print Design Fundamentals: While AI does the heavy lifting, you need a strong eye for typography, composition, and print formatting — specifically understanding bleed, margins, and how digital colors translate to physical paper.



Hyper-Organized: You know how to manage hundreds of daily files, prompts, and layout variations without losing track of upload statuses.



Self-Starter: You can take a general concept, write the sentiment, generate the art, and hand over a ready-to-publish folder with minimal supervision.



How to Apply



To ensure you have read this entire post and pay attention to detail, please include the word "STATIONERY" in the subject line of your application.



Please reply with the following:



A brief summary of your personal workflow for finding profitable greeting card niches and sentiments.



A link to your portfolio showing greeting card designs, typography, or layouts you have created (preferably using Ideogram, ChatGPT, or Google Flow).

title: Head of Lead Generation — Credit Repair Industry Experience Required
description:
CP Restoration Services

Job Description

POSITION AT A GLANCE

Job Title: Head of Lead Generation

Department: Sales & Marketing

Reports To: Owner / CEO (Jason Crown)

Location: Remote (US-based preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Commission on closed deals sourced)

Company: CP Restoration Services | 



ABOUT CROWN CREDIT PRO

CP Restoration Services is a leading credit repair company founded in 2014 with over 7,000 clients nationwide. We specialize in disputing inaccurate and negative items across all three major credit bureaus — Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion — helping our clients achieve financial freedom through better credit. We are a fast-growing company with a team spanning the US and the Philippines, and we are now looking for a driven, strategic leader to own and scale our entire lead generation engine.



ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Lead Generation is responsible for building, managing, and continuously optimizing the full pipeline of qualified leads that feed the CP Restoration Services sales team. This person owns everything from the top of the funnel — awareness and lead capture — to the handoff of sales-ready leads to our sales representatives. You will design and execute a multi-channel lead generation strategy including referral partner development, paid digital advertising, organic/SEO content,
 marketing, and social media. You will also build the systems and automations that ensure no lead falls through the cracks and every prospect receives timely, consistent follow-up.

This is a high-impact, high-accountability role. Sales are the lifeblood of CP Restoration Services and you will be directly responsible for the revenue pipeline.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Referral Partner Development

• Identify, recruit, and manage referral partnerships with mortgage brokers, real estate agents, auto dealerships (F&I managers), CPAs, tax preparers, financial advisors, and apartment leasing offices.

• Build co-branded marketing materials and custom landing pages for each referral partner.

• Implement a referral tracking system (PartnerStack or equivalent) so partners can monitor their referrals and commissions in real time.

• Set monthly referral volume targets and maintain relationships through regular check-ins.

2. Paid Digital Advertising

• Plan, launch, and manage
 and Instagram lead generation ad campaigns targeting individuals with credit challenges.

• Manage Google Search Ads campaigns targeting high-intent keywords such as “credit repair near me” and “remove collections from credit report.”

• Explore YouTube and TikTok ad opportunities to build brand awareness and generate inbound leads at lower cost.

• Monitor cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, and ROAS across all paid channels and optimize weekly.

• Manage the ad budget efficiently and report performance to ownership monthly.

3. Lead Funnel & CRM Management

• Ensure every lead from every source flows automatically into HubSpot CRM via Zapier or native integrations.

• Build and maintain 7-touch automated follow-up sequences in HubSpot 
 + SMS) so no lead goes uncontacted.

• Establish speed-to-lead protocols so every inbound lead is contacted within 5 minutes of submission.

• Segment leads by source, credit profile, and intent level to prioritize the sales team’s outreach.

• Source and manage aged lead lists (
 or equivalent) as a cost-effective supplementary channel.

4. Organic Lead Generation & Content

• Manage and fully optimize the CP Restoration Services Google Business Profile, including generating a consistent flow of 5-star reviews from satisfied clients.

• Oversee an SEO content strategy targeting high-intent searches by clients seeking credit repair help.

• Manage social media content calendar 
, Instagram, TikTok) with 3–5 posts per week, including educational content, client success stories, and promotional offers.

• Use tools like Buffer or Later to schedule and automate content publishing.

5. Analytics & Reporting

• Track and report weekly on key metrics: leads generated by channel, cost per lead, lead-to-appointment rate, appointment-to-close rate, and cost per acquired client.

• Benchmark against industry standards (15–20% lead-to-client conversion rate, $150–$300 cost per client acquisition).

• Use A/B testing on ad creative, landing pages, and
 subject lines to continuously improve conversion rates.

• Present a monthly lead generation report to the CEO with insights, wins, and next-month strategy.

6. Sales Team Enablement

• Collaborate with the Sales Manager to ensure lead handoff is seamless and leads arrive with full context (source, credit score range, goal).

• Develop call scripts,
 templates, and follow-up sequences for the sales team to use with incoming leads.

• Work with the Sales Manager to identify which lead sources produce the highest close rates and double down on those channels.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• 3+ years of experience in lead generation, growth marketing, or demand generation — ideally in financial services, credit repair, mortgage, real estate, or a related industry.

• Proven track record of building and scaling multi-channel lead generation programs that directly drove revenue growth.

• Hands-on experience running and optimizing
/Instagram Lead Ads and Google Search Ads campaigns.

• Proficiency with HubSpot CRM, including building automated sequences, managing pipelines, and reporting.

• Strong understanding of referral partner programs and experience building B2B referral networks.

• Experience with Zapier or 
 for marketing automation and CRM integrations.

• Data-driven mindset — you track everything and make decisions based on numbers, not gut feel.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

• Prior experience in the credit repair, mortgage lending, or personal finance industry.

• Familiarity with Credit Repair Cloud or similar credit repair CRM platforms.

• Experience with SEO content strategy and managing a content calendar.

• Knowledge of CROA (Credit Repair Organizations Act) marketing compliance requirements.

• Experience managing remote teams or coordinating with offshore tea
mbers.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by the following metrics, reviewed monthly:



KPI Target

Qualified leads generated per month 200+ (ramp to 500+ within 6 months)

Cost per lead (paid channels) Under $25

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate 25%+

Overall lead-to-client conversion rate 15–20?tive referral partnerships 10 within 60 days, 25+ within 6 months

Speed to lead (contact within) 5 minutes of lead submission



WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience.

• Performance bonus tied directly to qualified leads and closed deals sourced — the better you perform, the more you earn.

• 100% remote position with flexible working hours.

• A company with 10+ years of history, 7,000+ clients, and a proven service that sells itself.

• Direct access to and support from the founder/CEO.

• A clear mandate: you own lead generation. Your results are visible and rewarded.

• Opportunity to build and lead your own lead generation team as the company scales.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please send the following to 

• Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

• A brief cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining your lead generation experience and why you are the right person for this role.

• One example of a lead generation campaign you built — what you did, the results, and what you learned.

Applications without a cover letter and campaign example will not be reviewed.

description:

The type of content will vary depending on the client. You may work on short-form social media videos, talking-head content, podcasts, YouTube videos, promotional videos, ads, and other content commonly found on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube.



Because every client has a different brand, you should be comfortable adapting to different editing styles rather than following only one type of edit.



## Responsibilities



Your role will mainly focus on post-production, which may include:



* Organizing and reviewing raw footage

* Cutting and pacing videos

* Removing mistakes, pauses, and unnecessary sections

* Adding captions, B-roll, music, sound effects, graphics, and transitions

* Cleaning and improving audio

* Basic color correction and color grading

* Following client references, instructions, and brand guidelines

* Making revisions based on feedback

* Using AI tools when they can improve the workflow, speed, or quality of the final output

* Keeping project files and assets properly organized



You do not need to know every AI tool available, but you should be comfortable learning and using AI-assisted tools when needed.



## What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Is reliable and communicates clearly

* Pays close attention to small details

* Can follow instructions and references accurately

* Is comfortable working with different editing styles

* Can manage deadlines responsibly

* Is open to feedback and revisions

* Can work independently after receiving instructions

* Has a stable internet connection and a computer capable of editing videos



There is no minimum number of years of experience required. Your portfolio and actual editing ability matter more than how long you have been editing.



## Software



The necessary software and tools for the projects will be provided.



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro is required because project files and timelines may need to be reviewed or transferred.



Knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, Canva, or AI editing tools is helpful but not required.



## Work Arrangement



This is a part-time, freelance, and project-based position.



Work will be offered whenever we need additional help with client projects. Weekly hours are not guaranteed, but we are looking for someone we can work with consistently over the long term.



You will work directly with me and receive clear instructions, references, and feedback for each project.



## Rate



The starting rate is **$5 USD per hour**.



This is intended to be a long-term working relationship for the right editor.



## Paid Test Project



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



The test will help us evaluate your editing ability, attention to detail, communication, file organization, and ability to follow instructions.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and the types of videos you usually edit.

2. One of the best videos you have personally edited.

3. A screenshot of the Adobe Premiere Pro timeline for that same video so we can verify that you worked on the project.

4. Your current availability and how many hours you can usually work each week.

5. A list of the video editing and AI tools you have experience using.



Please do not send your entire portfolio. Choose one strong video that best represents the quality of your work.



We are looking to hire someone who can start as soon as possible.

title: Video Editor
description:
Part-Time | Remote | £4 per hour



About the Role

We are recruiting on behalf of a growing UK-based marketing business seeking an experienced and creative Video Editor to produce engaging short-form content for a range of service-based businesses.

This role is primarily focused on creating high-quality videos for platforms including Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You'll work from clear briefs and reference examples to produce content that captures attention, retains viewers, and delivers a professional finish.



You'll be provided with detailed project briefs, examples of the desired editing style, and all the assets needed to complete each project. We're looking for someone who can take ownership of the editing process and consistently deliver content with minimal supervision.



Note: This is not an entry-level editing role. We are looking for an experienced editor who understands social media, storytelling, and audience retention.



Working Hours

Part-Time | Flexible Working Hours

10 hours per week. Work can be completed around agreed deadlines, with flexibility to suit both parties.



Key Responsibilities



Video Editing

Edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Produce high-quality edits typically between 30–90 seconds

Follow detailed creative briefs and reference examples

Deliver polished videos ready for publishing

Ensure all edits align with brand guidelines and project objectives



Motion Graphics & Visual Effects

Create animated captions and subtitles

Add motion graphics and visual effects

Incorporate smooth transitions, zooms, and camera movements

Integrate music and sound effects to enhance engagement

Apply creative editing techniques that maximise audience retention



Project Management

Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously

Deliver projects within agreed deadlines

Implement revisions where required

Maintain organised project files and workflows

Communicate progress and timelines effectively



Content Optimisation

Create edits designed specifically for social media performance

Apply best practices for viewer engagement and retention

Stay up to date with current editing styles and social media trends

Continuously look for ways to improve content quality and performance



Essential Skills & Experience

Proven experience editing short-form social media content

Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

Experience using Adobe After Effects

Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention

Experience creating animated captions, motion graphics, and engaging visual effects

Strong understanding of social media content trends and platform-specific editing styles

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong organisational and time management skills

Excellent written and spoken English



Desirable Skills

Experience using Adobe Photoshop

Experience editing content for marketing agencies or service-based businesses

Familiarity with multiple social media platforms and content strategies

Basic graphic design experience

Experience creating reusable editing templates and workflows



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:

Has several years of professional video editing experience

Takes ownership of projects from start to finish

Produces consistently high-quality work

Requires minimal supervision

Can accurately follow creative briefs

Has a strong eye for detail and design

Understands what makes social media content perform well

Is reliable, organised, and consistently meets deadlines

Continuously looks for ways to improve the quality of their work



What This Role Isn't

Not an entry-level editing position

Not basic video trimming or simple edits

Not someone who requires constant guidance

Not missing deadlines or delivering inconsistent work

Not creating long-form YouTube content



How to Apply

Use "Vixa Video Editor" in the subject line of your application.

Send your resume and cover letter.

Include your portfolio or examples of your best short-form video edits.

Please also include your internet speed test result and a screenshot of your laptop or PC specifications.

If you're an experienced video editor with a passion for creating engaging social media content and can consistently deliver high-quality edits with minimal supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Historical Research Assistant (Remote)
description:
Part-Time Historical Research Assistant (Remote)



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)



Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week



Compensation: $150 USD every two weeks (approximately 20 hours every two weeks). Opportunity for increased hours and pay based on performance.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Historical Research Assistant to help uncover compelling stories about Black history in Austin, Texas. We create educational social media content, tours, documentaries, and public history projects that connect present-day places to their deeper historical roots.



This is an excellent position for someone who enjoys research, organizing information, and finding credible historical sources.



Responsibilities



* Conduct online historical research using archives, census records, newspapers, university collections, maps, historical societies, and other credible sources.

* Locate primary and secondary sources related to assigned topics.

* Organize findings into easy-to-read research briefs.

* Maintain citations and links for every source used.

* Find public-domain or properly licensed historical images when available.

* Build spreadsheets and databases of historical people, places, and events.

* Summarize information clearly without adding opinions or speculation.

* Work closely with our team to support educational storytelling projects.



Please include the word LONGHORN in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include this keyword will not be considered.



Qualifications



* Excellent English reading and writing skills.

* Strong internet research abilities.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Able to distinguish between credible and non-credible sources.

* Experience with Google Docs, Google Sheets, and basic spreadsheet organization.

* Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools is a plus, but all information must be verified with reliable sources.



This Position Is NOT



This is not a content writing position.



This is not a social media management position.



This is not an administrative virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys digging through historical records, organizing evidence, and documenting sources accurately.



To Apply



In your application, briefly answer:



1. Why does this position interest you?

2. Describe a research project you’ve completed (academic, professional, or personal).

3. What tools or websites do you typically use when researching information online?



Hiring Process



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a small paid research assignment before interviews are conducted. This assignment is designed to evaluate research ability, organization, attention to detail, and communication skills. All applicants who are invited to this stage will be compensated for completing the assignment.



We value curiosity, integrity, and attention to detail more than formal education. If you enjoy uncovering hidden stories and organizing information in a meaningful way, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:

airtable(dot) com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via
, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our tea
mbers as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.



- Real Career Growth: We're expanding quickly, which means new roles and responsibilities open up regularly. We actively develop our people through mentorship, skill-building, and increasing ownership of projects.



- A Team That Feels Like a Team: We're a close, collaborative group that celebrates wins together. You'll know your teammates by name, including leadership.





HiEnd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Disputer - EXPEDITED Credit Repair
description:
We help business owners fix their credit and then get approved for $50K to $150K+ in funding. Credit repair is the front door. A lot of people come to us close but not quite fundable, and your job is to get them there: cleaner reports, higher scores, the right profile, ready to fund.



We're looking for a Credit Repair Specialist to own that whole journey. You'll take someone with real problems on their report and walk them out the other side funding-ready. Right now this work lives in the founder's head, and we need you to run it better than he could.



This is not a mill where you fire off template disputes and hope. You'll manage a real book of clients and actually move their numbers, the right way.



HOW THIS WORKS



This is a part-time role, and that's on purpose. Credit repair here isn't a 40-hour seat with busywork to fill the day. You manage a book of clients on your own schedule. A book of 10 to 20 clients runs about 10 to 15 hours a week for someone who knows what they're doing.



You get paid when a client reaches funding-ready, and again when that client funds. Slow month means less work and less pay. Busy month means more of both. If you're the type who wants to run a solid book without a boss watching the clock, this setup is built for you. We'll go over the exact numbers on the call.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Pull and read full reports across all three bureaus and figure out exactly what's holding the score back.



Build a repair plan: which items to dispute, what to pay down, what to add, and a realistic timeline to funding-ready.



Run the dispute process end to end. File it, track the bureau responses, re-dispute where it makes sense, handle validation. Follow it through the full cycle instead of firing and forgetting.



Coach clients on the behavior that actually moves a score. Utilization, on-time payments, and not opening the wrong accounts at the wrong time.



Track score movement and keep clients motivated through a process that takes months, not days.



Get clients to funding-ready with a 700+ score and a clean profile, then hand them clean to the funding side.



Keep the CRM current. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Read this first: this role is for experienced credit repair specialists only. Not for beginners. If you're new to credit or you're hoping to learn on the job, this isn't it, and we'll know within one question on the interview call.



You've read full credit reports before and you know what drags a score down and how to bring it back up. This one is non-negotiable.



You know the dispute process and the rules around it. You work clean and compliant, and you never promise a client something you can't legally deliver.



Familiar with CFPB, BBB, FTC, FCRA, and FDCPA.



You're the kind of organized where nothing slips. You can carry 25 to 30+ clients at once and keep every one moving.



Your written and spoken English is clean and professional. Clients trust you inside the first five minutes.



You actually like working with clients. You follow up before they have to chase you.



You're independent. Give you a goal and a playbook and you run with it. You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what to do next.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience in funding as well as credit repair, so you understand where the client is headed after you.



Time spent in a CRM like GoHighLevel, Notion, Clickup, or something similar.



You've helped build or tighten up SOPs, not just followed them.



WHAT YOU GET



A real book of clients who want to be here, not a spammy cold list.



Playbooks and templates so you're not guessing. Where they don't exist yet, you'll help build them.



Direct access to the founder. No layers, no politics.



Room to grow into running the whole credit side as we scale.



HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOU



You'll know exactly what winning looks like. Once you're ramped, here's what we expect:



Plans out fast. Every client has a repair plan within 3 business days of onboarding.



Scores that move. Clients see real, steady score improvement, and a strong share reach funding-ready inside 60 to 90 days.



Disputes that don't stall. Every dispute cycle tracked and actioned on time. Nothing sits waiting on you.



Follow-through. 85%+ of your clients do their part (paydowns, docs, action steps) on schedule, because you're staying on them.



Nobody goes dark. Every active client hears from you at least once a week with a real update, not a "just checking in."



Clean handoffs. When a client hits funding-ready, they move to the funding side with a full, accurate file. No gaps.



CRM stays current. Statuses and notes updated the same day, every day. No end-of-week catch-up.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



Your resume



2 to 3 sentences on your credit repair experience. Be specific about what you've actually done, not what you've read about.



One example of a client whose credit you meaningfully improved, and how you did it.



Use the subject line: "Clean Slate"



Applications without that subject line or without real credit experience won't get read. We work in the details here, so show us yours.

You are welcome to visit www.enchantedboa.love to get a sense of the work, values, and energy behind the business. There is no need to be personally involved in the spiritual or healing fields, but respect, openness, and comfort working with a purpose-driven and unconventional business are important.

• Following up on missing receipts or unclear transactions

• Maintaining clear digital folders and bookkeeping records

• Helping improve and simplify existing financial processes

• Communicating with me and, when necessary, coordinating with an accountant

• Creating checklists, routines, and systems that require as little ongoing maintenance as possible



Experience and skills

You should have:

• Previous bookkeeping or accounting-related experience

• Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Confidence working with spreadsheets and financial records

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and spoken English

Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

You do not need to speak Finnish or Portuguese fluently, but you should feel comfortable working with receipts and documents in these languages and using translation tools when needed.



The kind of person I am looking for



I would love to work with someone who is:

• Warm and professional in communication

• Naturally organized and detail-oriented

• Comfortable supporting a creative and somewhat unconventional business

• Interested in finding practical and creative solutions

• Willing to learn and grow together with the role



I value transparency, kindness, clear communication, and mutual respect. I am looking for a long-term working relationship with someone who genuinely enjoys helping a small business become more financially organized and sustainable.



Hours and working arrangement

title: Accommodation Coordinator — Close Deals Across Europe (Base + Commission)
description:
We arrange corporate housing across Europe for companies relocating employee groups (construction, engineering, corporate teams, 5 to 25 people at a time). Inquiries come in daily. Your job is to own the case end to end: qualify the client, source the landlord, negotiate the terms, and close it.



This is not an admin or coordination-only role. What we need is someone who can get on a call with a skeptical landlord or a hesitant client and actually move the deal forward without hand-holding.



Pay is base plus 8% commission on every deal you personally close, paid monthly for the full length of the stay (a 6-month lease pays 6 months of commission). If you're looking for a flat hourly rate with no upside, this isn't the right fit.



If we proceed, you have one week to show results, not excuses. Real cases, real deadlines, real client and landlord conversations from day one. If day one turns into stories about why nothing moved, this ends fast.



Before you apply: record a 3-minute video of yourself doing this roleplay solo. You're calling a landlord in Amsterdam about a unit for a corporate client (3 people, 6 months). The landlord asks who the client is and what they're paying. Protect the client's identity, don't disclose your margin, and if the landlord quotes a high rate, push back using the long-term-tenancy angle. 

Attach the recording link with your application. Applications without one won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Video Editor (Long-Form VSLs & Meta Ads)
description:
Senior Video Editor (Long-Form VSLs & Meta Ads) – Full-Time



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand focused on building high-converting video ads for Meta.



[Briefly explain your company and product here.]



Example:



* What product(s) do you sell?

* Who is your target audience?

* What makes your product unique?

* Why does your product work differently from competitors?

* What problem does it solve?



?



What we’re really after (please read this carefully)



This is the most important part of the role, so we’ll be direct about it.



Our biggest growth opportunity sits at the very top of the funnel — with cold, “unaware” and “problem-aware” audiences.



These are people who experience the problem every day but don’t yet understand the real cause behind it. They often haven’t connected the dots yet and may not even know a solution exists.



That means our ads shouldn’t immediately mention diagnoses, product categories, or obvious solutions. Instead, our best-performing ads:



* Lead with a relatable symptom, frustration, or everyday situation.

* Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never considered.

* Naturally bridge into the solution, proof, and offer.



We’re specifically looking for an editor who can build long-form, top-of-funnel storytelling ads that educate and reframe—not just conversion edits for warm audiences.



Our videos are getting longer, not shorter. The ability to keep a cold viewer engaged for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable skill you can bring.



This is a senior role. We’re not looking for someone who’s still learning. We need someone who has already edited high-performing long-for
ta ads and can prove it.



?



What you’ll be doing



* Edit long-form VSL ads (2–4+ minutes) designed to move cold audiences from problem awareness to purchase.

* Build narrative arcs:

    * Hook

    * Problem

    * Reframe

    * Solution

    * Proof

    * CTA

* Edit with strong pacing for retention (cuts every 2–4 seconds, captions, motion graphics, B-roll layering).

* Work from structured creative briefs and customer avatars.

* Translate written scripts into emotionally engaging visual stories.



?



What this role is NOT



We’re not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together.



We’re looking for someone who understands:



* Why a 3-minute Meta ad keeps a cold audience watching.

* How to layer B-roll, text, music and AI visuals to build narrative tension.

* Which first five seconds matter most.

* How pacing and visual rhythm influence retention.

* How editing differs between unaware audiences and audiences ready to buy.



?



Requirements



* Senior-level experience editing long-form/VSL Meta ads.

* Proven experience with direct-response advertising.

* Please share examples.

* Strong AI image and AI video generation skills.

* Experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects or CapCut Pro.

* Understanding of performance marketing.

* Ability to transform scripts into engaging visual stories.

* Experience with captions, motion graphics, color grading and B-roll.

* Ability to source stock footage, UGC and brand assets.

* Fluent English.



Nice to have



* Experience editing for older demographics.

* Experience within health, wellness or similar consumer niches.



?



What we offer



* Full-time position (8 hours per day).

* Long-term opportunity.

* Clear systems, customer avatars, scripts and creative briefs.

* Room to grow with the company.

* Direct collaboration with the creative strategist.

title: Senior Creative Strategist Lead
description:
We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist to join our eCommerce team and create high performing ad concepts, hooks, scripts, advertorials, landing page messaging, and creative briefs for our DTC brands.



This role is ideal for someone with strong direct-response experience who understands buyer psychology, performance marketing, Meta ads, and what makes creatives convert.



This is not a basic content writing role. We need someone who can research winning ads, find strong angles, write persuasive copy, and create ad concepts that are ready for production and testing.



Key Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be to write strong direct-response ad concepts, hooks, scripts, advertorial copy, landing page messaging, and creative briefs that can help us test and scale winning creatives.



You will be responsible for turning product research, customer pain points, competitor swipes, and performance learnings into strong ad ideas.



What You’ll Do



* Research winning ads, competitors, customer pain points, and market trends

* Create strong ad angles, hooks, scripts, and UGC-style concepts

* Write high-converting ad copy, primary text, headlines, captions, and CTA variations

* Write advertorial copy, presell page copy, and landing page messaging

* Create clear creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators

* Build creative concepts based on direct-response principles and buyer psychology

* Analyze creative performance and suggest new iterations based on data

* Identify new hooks, emotional triggers, formats, and messaging opportunities

* Work closely with media buyers, video editors, and the creative team

* Make sure all ad concepts are clear, persuasive, and production-ready



What We’re Looking For



* 3+ years of experience as a Creative Strategist in DTC eCommerce, ideally with 6 to 7 figure brands

* Strong hands on copywriting ability across ads, scripts, advertorials, and landing pages

* Proven ability to write high-converting direct response copy

* Strong understanding of hooks, angles, buyer psychology, UGC ads, Meta ads, and performance marketing

* Ability to analyze winning ads and adapt the structure to new products

* Experience writing creative briefs for editors and UGC creators

* Strong understanding of what makes ad creatives convert on Meta

* Experience with supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or consumer products is a strong plus

* High standards, strong attention to detail, and fast execution



You Are a Great Fit If You:



* Can instantly identify strong and weak hooks

* Know how to turn customer pain points into strong ad angles

* Understand direct-response copywriting and performance creative strategy

* Can write scripts that feel native, persuasive, and conversion focused

* Are comfortable working with swipes, competitor ads, landing pages, and performance data

* Can create multiple strong creative concepts quickly

* Care about performance, testing, and improving results



This Role Is Not For You If:



* You only write basic captions or generic content

* You are focused only on brand storytelling and not performance marketing

* You give random ad ideas without strong reasoning

* You cannot explain why a hook, angle, or script should work

* You are not comfortable writing direct-response ads for paid traffic



You Should Be Confident Writing:



* Hooks

* Ad angles

* UGC scripts

* Primary text

* Headlines

* CTA variations

* Creative briefs

* Advertorial copy

* Presell page copy

* Landing page messaging

* Offer messaging

* Emotional and conversion-focused copy



Work Setup



* Full time remote role

* Long term opportunity

* Clear systems and SOPs provided

* You will work closely with our media buying, creative, editing, and strategy teams

* Availability overlap with our team will be required



Compensation



The base salary is $3,000/month. A commission structure is also included and will be discussed during the interview. Commission is tied to creative performance and output quality.



Hiring Process



1. Application review

6. Trial period

7. Final offer and onboarding

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager  SOPs | KPIs | 3+ Years)
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

- You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

- You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

- You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

- Excellent English, written and verbal

- Familiarity with Amazon tools

- You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,800–$2000+/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

- Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

- Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

- Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions:



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?

- The role will begin with clearly scoped work alongside our existing development process. Continued work and greater ownership will depend on the quality, reliability, communication, and judgment you demonstrate.

- Developers who earn the team’s trust will have opportunities to take responsibility for features, technical decisions, and larger areas of project work.



HOW WE WORK

- We use Claude Code and Codex as part of our development process.

- You should be comfortable with AI-assisted development while remaining responsible for understanding, testing, reviewing, and explaining everything you deliver. AI tools are part of the workflow, but they are not a substitute for engineering judgment.



We work through:

- Clear planning before implementation

- Small, reviewable changes

- Meaningful automated tests

- Incremental Git commits

- Concise technical documentation

- Careful review of AI-generated code

- Regular communication about progress, decisions, and blockers

- Because this is a remote role, reliability matters. You must provide useful daily progress reports, respond to work messages promptly, raise blockers early, and attend scheduled meetings prepared and on time.



Technologies you may work with

- Python and FastAPI

- TypeScript and JavaScript

- React and Next.js

- REST APIs

- SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL

- Git and GitHub

- Azure, AWS, or similar cloud infrastructure

- Claude Code and Codex



What we expect you to know

- Building REST APIs with clear contracts, validation, and error handling

- Authentication and authorization

- Data modelling and relational databases

- Concurrent and asynchronous Python

- React and Next.js beyond the basics

- Testing and debugging production code

- Git and incremental development workflows

- Writing documentation that other developers can follow

- Reviewing and taking responsibility for AI-assisted code

- You do not need to be an expert in everything. You do need to be methodical, honest about what you know, and capable of learning without hiding behind tools.



What would set you apart

- Experience with Azure, AWS, or similar cloud infrastructure

- PostgreSQL experience

- Playwright or other automated testing tools

- CI/CD and production deployment experience

- Strong asynchronous Python knowledge

- Experience collaborating in a small remote team

- Clear examples of taking ownership after earning a team’s trust



How we evaluate

1. Applicants complete a short two-part technical challenge:

- One project completed without AI coding assistance

- One project completed using AI tools, with full prompt documentation

- We are not testing how much complexity you can produce. We are evaluating how you think, plan, communicate, write and test code, use development tools, and approach your work.

- Communication and reliability carry as much weight as technical ability. Strong code is not enough if you cannot keep a remote team informed, meet commitments, and work consistently without repeated follow-up.



How to apply

- Do not apply through the job board’s standard application process. Applications submitted through other channels will not be reviewed.

- Complete the technical challenge and submit your application through our portal:

title: Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY: 



Noserider Surf Club makes surf suits that stay on. Handmade in Bali, sold worldwide via 
, a retail shop in Canggu, and a growing roster of wholesale partners. Functionality and sustainability go hand in hand. Our customers care about both, and so do we.



We're small, fast, and protective of the brand. Social is where a lot of new customers meet us for the first time, and we're at the point where it needs a dedicated owner so the founder can keep building.





ABOUT THE FOUNDER: 



Emma founded Noserider after moving to Bali to surf and finding nothing on the market that was both supportive in the water and something she actually wanted to wear. She sketched the first surf set herself, worked with a local tailor to make it, and built the brand from there. 



She still runs Noserider day to day from Bali, hands-on with the factories, and owns product and creative direction. She's the person you'd be working with most closely in this role. 



More on Emma's story here: 
 





ABOUT THE ROLE: 



We're hiring a part-time Social Media Manager to own the day-to-day of Noserider's Instagram and TikTok. We already have a deep library of content: product photos, video, and behind-the-scenes footage from Bali. This role turns that raw material into a consistent, on-brand presence and a steady flow of fresh ad creative.



The work is fast and hands-on. You watch what's trending on TikTok and Reels, spot the formats that fit Noserider, and cut our footage into them. You keep a steady pipeline of ad creative going out, testing different hooks and edits so there's always something fresh to run. You also own the posting calendar and keep it consistent. This is daily editing and posting, not the occasional hero video.



Emma still creates the founder-voice and story-driven pieces herself, and creative direction stays with her. This isn't a strategy or art-direction seat. It's for someone genuinely fast and good at turning raw footage into short-form video that performs.





WHO THRIVES HERE: 



The person who thrives here lives on TikTok and Reels and genuinely enjoys it. You hear a trending audio or spot a format and immediately see how Noserider's footage could fit it. You're fast in the edit, you have taste, and you care about the small details that make a post feel native to the platform instead of like an ad.



You're also organized. You take a library of raw clips and turn it into a planned, consistent posting schedule without being chased. You keep the calendar full and the ad creative flowing, so Emma can stay focused on product, brand, and the work only she can do.





RESPONSIBILITIES: 



- Sort, edit, and publish content from our existing library into consistent, on-brand posts for Instagram and TikTok

- Edit short-form video (CapCut or similar): hooks, captions, trending audio, clean cuts

- Watch trends and reformat our footage into the formats that are working right now

- Produce a steady stream of ad creatives, giving us multiple variations to test so we always have fresh creative to run

- Schedule and publish posts (we use Later)

- Write captions that sound like the brand (you can lean on AI to draft, but the voice has to land)

- Keep our content organized so nothing good gets lost in the library





REQUIREMENTS::



- Strong hands-on short-form video editing (CapCut or similar) for Instagram and TikTok

- A portfolio or examples of Reels/TikToks you've edited

- Real experience producing ad creatives and testing variations

- Experience with trend research and finding creative ways to fit a brand into what's trending

- A strong design eye: you make polished, on-brand graphics in Canva, not just basic templates

- Good written English for captions

- Based in the Philippines, available part-time (around 20 hrs/week), with some working-hour overlap with Bali (UTC+8)

- Reliable internet and your own editing setup



Bonus points if you have:



- Experience using AI tools for video editing (auto-captions, AI cuts, generative b-roll, etc.)

- Experience running or supporting an active Instagram or TikTok for an apparel, fashion, or lifestyle brand

- Surfing, surf culture interest, or any lived experience that helps you feel the brand

- Experience with Later or a similar scheduling tool





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? 



- $600 USD/month, part-time (around 20 hrs/week), with the possibility of becoming full-time

- Paid monthly

- The first 30 days is a paid probation period to make sure the fit is right for both parties; we'll reassess together at the 30-day mark

- Fully remote, with some overlap with Bali (UTC+8)

- A long-term role inside a small team building a real brand

- Direct working relationship with the founder





HOW TO APPLY?



Apply via our application form:: 
 

We read every application.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment
